title: PhD Positions in Human-Robot Interaction for Welfare Robotics
description:
SDU Robotics, part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more 3-year PhD positions, as part of the newly launched ROBOWELL project. The starting date will be agreed with the successful candidate. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

 

Project description
As part of the newly launched ROBOWELL project, we are now seeking a talented and motivated PhD candidate.

ROBOWELL aims to develop a Nordic model for the integration of social robots in welfare services, including elderly care. The project brings together partners from Denmark, Norway, and Sweden, and the successful candidate will be part of a strong interdisciplinary and international collaboration, collaborating with PhD fellows at partner institutions.

At SDU Robotics, the candidate will become part of a dynamic research environment with ongoing projects in robotics, computer vision, and human-robot interaction, and will contribute to both research and teaching activities within the unit. We are embedded in a strong national and international network and collaborate closely with the Center for Clinical Robotics, located at SDU and Odense University Hospital, providing unique opportunities for translational research in real-world healthcare settings.

 

Required Qualifications
Applicants must hold a master’s degree in robotics, engineering, computer science, or a closely related, relevant field by the time of employment. Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are also encouraged to apply.

Strong competencies in most of the following areas are expected:

  • Human-Robot Interaction

  • Experiment design

  • Robot systems integration (mechanics, electronics, control)

  • Computer Vision

Familiarity with the welfare or health-care domain would be considered an advantage, but not essential.

In addition, the candidate should:

  • Have experience with ROS and object-oriented programming

  • Demonstrate excellent written and spoken English

  • Be able to work both independently and collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams

  • Communicate fluently in Danish (preferred) or another Scandinavian language

 

Research environment 
SDU Robotics is a unit within the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU). We are a team of approximately 60 employees based in Odense. We actively work across traditional disciplinary boundaries to develop new technologies and scientific knowledge. Our research contributes to novel solutions with applications in industrial automation, lab automation, welfare, and healthcare. Furthermore, the unit has a long-standing tradition of collaboration with industrial partners.

We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international working environment with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your growth as a researcher within the field of robotics.  

 

Further information
Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

Further information about this position is available via email from Associate Professor Leon Bodenhagen (lebo@mmmi.sdu.dk) or Associate Professor Oskar Palinko (ospa@mmmi.sdu.dk ).

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

ODENSE
As the 3rd largest city in Denmark, Odense provides the perfect combination of a historic city center with an urban field yet a close proximity to beaches and recreational areas. Its location on the beautiful island of Funen is ideal with easy access by train or highway to the bigger cities of Aarhus and Copenhagen; direct trains can take you straight to Copenhagen airport in less than 2 hours. Since 1966 the city has been a university town, and strong collaborative ties are in place between the University of Southern Denmark and the many Danish and International corporations in the region. As the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Denmark’s famous fairytale author, the city is home to a vibrant and creative population that hosts numerous festivals and markets throughout the year.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

 

The application deadline is August 2, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivation letter stating your specific interest, motivation and qualifications for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae including personal contact information.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Conditions of employment/enrollment
Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 36.608 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). Further information about salary and conditions of employment. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

title: Lead Data Engineer (m/w/d) (Data Engineer)
description:
Als **Lead Data Engineer (m/w/d)** verbindest du hands-on Engineering mit technischer Führung und prägst die Weiterentwicklung unseres Databricks-basierten Datenökosystems. Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenplattform. Du arbeitest eng mit Engineers, Architekt:innen, Product Ownern und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst technische Entscheidungen, die sowohl kurzfristige Anforderungen als auch langfristige strategische Ziele unterstützen. Du verstehst, wie die Arbeit des Engineering-Teams zu konkreten Geschäftsergebnissen beiträgt.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für das Data-Engineering-Team und prägst maßgeblich die technische Ausrichtung unserer Data-Engineering-Praktiken im gesamten Unternehmen. Du schreibst Code, definierst Standards und unterstützt sowie coachst andere Engineers. Gleichzeitig bist du die zentrale technische Eskalationsstelle für komplexe Herausforderungen.

Zu deinen Kernaufgaben gehören:

- Die Leitung von Design, Entwicklung und Optimierung von Data-Lösungen im Enterprise-Maßstab auf Databricks
- Die Konzeption und Implementierung skalierbarer Data-Ingestion-Frameworks für Batch- und Streaming-Workloads
- Die Verantwortung für Databricks Asset Bundles / Declarative Automation Bundles, Deployment-Pipelines und Multi-Environment-Konfigurationen
- Die Steuerung von Data-Governance-Initiativen über Unity Catalog, inklusive Access Management, Storage Credentials und Metadatenverwaltung
- Die Definition und Pflege von Engineering-Standards wie Coding Practices, Code Reviews, Dokumentation und Data-Quality-Frameworks
- Das Coaching anderer Data Engineers sowie die Übernahme der technischen Eskalation bei komplexen Herausforderungen

Profil

Du bist eine **hands-on technische Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit umfassender Databricks-Erfahrung. Du denkst über die unmittelbare Aufgabe hinaus, hast die gesamte Plattform im Blick und triffst Architekturentscheidungen mit Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit und langfristige Datenstrategie. Du verstehst die Verbindung zwischen Engineering-Output und Business-Impact und findest die Balance zwischen schneller Lieferung und nachhaltiger Governance.

Wir stellen uns vor, dass du:

- Umfassende praktische Erfahrung mit produktionsreifen Databricks-Lösungen hast
- Sehr sicher in Python, PySpark und SQL bist – inklusive komplexer Transformationen, Performanceoptimierung und Query-Design
- Erfahrung im Design von Databricks Asset Bundles und im Deployment über mehrere Umgebungen hinweg mitbringst
- Fundiertes Wissen über Unity Catalog, Data Governance, Access Control und Best Practices im Datenmanagement besitzt
- CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps oder ähnlichen Technologien aufgebaut und betrieben hast
- Architekturentscheidungen und technische Trade-offs klar und verständlich kommunizieren kannst – sowohl technisch als auch nicht-technisch - auf Deutsch und Englisch

Zusätzlich von Vorteil sind:

- Erfahrung mit Databricks AI/BI Dashboards, Genie oder Semantic Layer Design
- Kenntnisse im Azure Identity- und Secrets-Management, z. B. Entra ID, OIDC Federation und Azure Key Vault
- Erfahrung darin, GDPR- und Vertraulichkeitsanforderungen in Data-Engineering-Lösungen zu integrieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG wirst du Teil einer ambitionierten und kollaborativen Organisation, in der Daten eine immer wichtigere Rolle für Innovation und geschäftlichen Mehrwert spielen. Du erhältst die Chance, unsere moderne Datenplattform aktiv mitzugestalten und an strategischen Initiativen im gesamten Unternehmen mitzuwirken.

Wir bieten dir ein flexibles und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit hervorragenden Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, zum Wissensaustausch und zum beruflichen Wachstum. Dich erwartet eine Kultur, die von Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung geprägt ist.

Kontakt

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung im PDF-Format über unser Bewerbungsportal unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

title: PhD Stipend in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes
description:
Aalborg University, Department of Energy, Campus Esbjerg, invites applications for a three-year PhD Stipend from October 1st or soon hereafter in dynamic modelling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production. The project is primarily rooted in process engineering while also addressing the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid. You will contribute to interdisciplinary research spanning process engineering, power engineering and sustainable energy systems and help develop future large-scale Power-to-X solutions.

Your work tasks
In this PhD fellowship at AAU Energy, you will work with dynamic modeling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production, such as green methanol and sustainable aviation fuel produced through Fischer–Tropsch and methanol-to-jet pathways. The project primarily focuses on the process-engineering aspects of renewable fuel production, with particular emphasis on the interactions among the electrical grid, electrolysers, fuel-synthesis processes, energy storage and heat integration in integrated Power-to-X systems.

You will develop and apply physics-based process models that describe the behavior of Power-to-X plants under varying operating conditions. This includes modelling electrolysers, fuel-synthesis units and supporting energy-system components and analyzing how these systems can operate efficiently and flexibly in response to fluctuations in renewable electricity generation, energy prices and wider energy-system conditions. The work will combine process simulation with operational optimization, techno-economic assessment and model validation.

The research will also examine the coordinated operation and control of Power-to-X processes, electrolysers and energy-storage systems in interaction with the electrical grid. You will contribute to research on grid-supporting operation and control strategies for integrated Power-to-X plants.

You will carry out your research in close collaboration with academic and industrialpartners in Denmark and across Europe. The position includes, among others, preparing scientific publications, presenting results at conferences and workshops, and participating in project meetings and activities. You will also make a limited contribution to teaching or supervision at Aalborg University, for example by supervising bachelor’s and master’s students working on relevant topics.

Your competencies 
You have, or are about to obtain, a master’s degree in chemical engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, energy engineering, sustainable energy engineering or a closely related field. You bring a solid foundation in areas such as process modelling, thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics and control, optimization or energy-system analysis, and you are interested in applying these disciplines to Power-to-X and renewable fuel production.

You have experience with process-modelling tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS or other related software and are motivated to develop and apply dynamic models of energy and chemical processes. You are familiar with programming languages and computational tools. Expertise in a particular software package is not required, but experience with one or more computational environments, such as MATLAB, Python or similar tools, will support your work in the project. Knowledge of Power-to-X, electrolysis, renewable fuels, process integration or energy storage will be advantageous.

Knowledge of electrical power systems, electricity markets, grid integration or the control of grid-connected energy systems would strengthen your profile but is not a requirement for the position. The core academic profile sought is within process engineering or a related discipline. You should have an interest in and motivation to learn about the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid, including how process-level operation and control affect plant flexibility and system-level performance.

You are able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research environment. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external partners and are comfortable discussing technical ideas across disciplinary boundaries.
You have good analytical abilities, scientific curiosity, and the ability to document and communicate your work clearly in writing and presentations. You have strong written and spoken English skills suitable for scientific collaboration and publication. We value your motivation and potential to develop across disciplines, and you are not expected to have prior expertise in every aspect of the project from the outset.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
You will join the Fluid & Process research group at AAU Energy, Campus Esbjerg, where you will become part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment combining process, chemical, energy, and electrical engineering. The group works with modeling, simulation, control, optimization, and experimental validation of fluid and energy systems, with applications including Power-to-X, carbon capture and utilization, green fuels, and sector coupling. The working culture is collaborative and informal, with close interaction among academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, PhD fellows, and students. We share an ambition to contribute to the green transition through research with practical relevance.

At Campus Esbjerg, you will work alongside academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, and PhD fellows across a range of energy-related disciplines. The campus setting supports close day-to-day collaboration across disciplines and research projects.

Collaboration with industry is an important part of the research environment, and many research and student projects are developed with external partners to address real-world engineering challenges. We aim to provide a supportive working environment with a healthy balance between professional commitments and life outside work.

The fellowship offers strong opportunities for professional and academic development.
As part of the three-year PhD program, you will conduct independent research under supervision and complete PhD courses corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS.
Courses may be taken at Aalborg University or other relevant institutions in Denmark and abroad. You will have opportunities to participate in specialized courses, summer schools, international conferences, and project workshops. The position will also provide experience in scientific publishing, research dissemination, teaching or student supervision, interdisciplinary project work, and collaboration with industrial partners.

AAU Energy offers access to modern experimental and computational facilities supporting research in sustainable energy systems. At Campus Esbjerg, these include facilities for thermal and fluid processes, electrical engineering, power electronics, renewable-energy control, offshore energy systems, and Power-to-X.

The research environment is being further strengthened through the C-TECH initiative, which is establishing a modular test site for carbon capture, electrolysis, and methanol synthesis at Campus Esbjerg. The facility is intended to support research, education, and industrial collaboration in Power-to-X and carbon capture, utilization, and storage. This creates an attractive setting for a PhD project connecting process modeling with industrial validation and integrated sustainable-energy systems.

Campus Esbjerg is located in one of Denmark’s major energy and offshore hubs, providing favorable conditions for collaboration with companies involved in renewable energy, Power-to-X, offshore technologies, and the wider energy transition. The relatively compact campus supports close professional relationships, close interaction with supervisors and colleagues, and collaboration across research and educational activities.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that:
    describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Cleanroom & GMP Cleaning Specialist Pharma and Datacenter
description:
Cleanroom & Critical Environment Cleaning Specialist

Demonstrated experience working in both pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and hyperscale data centre environments is required.

About Vantage Support Group

Vantage Support Group provides specialist workforce and compliance services for pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and hyperscale data centres throughout Denmark.

We are seeking an experienced Cleanroom & Critical Environment Cleaning Specialist to join our team on high-security projects where precision, contamination control and strict compliance with quality standards are essential.

About the Position

The successful candidate will perform specialist cleaning in highly controlled environments, including:

  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities

  • GMP production areas

  • ISO 14644 classified cleanrooms

  • Critical environments within hyperscale data centres

  • Technical installations and commissioning areas

The role requires exceptional attention to detail and strict compliance with contamination control procedures, client requirements and health & safety regulations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform specialist cleaning of cleanrooms and controlled environments.

  • Clean technical installations and critical infrastructure.

  • Carry out GMP-compliant cleaning within pharmaceutical production areas.

  • Perform post-construction and commissioning cleaning within hyperscale data centres.

  • Follow ISO 14644 cleanroom standards.

  • Work in contamination-controlled environments.

  • Operate industrial cleaning equipment.

  • Operate heavy machinery including telehandlers, forklifts and MEWPs where required.

  • Maintain cleaning records and quality documentation.

  • Comply with all HSE and client procedures.

Essential Qualifications

Applicants must have:

  • Minimum 3 years of documented experience in specialist industrial cleaning.

  • Proven experience within pharmaceutical facilities and/or hyperscale data centres.

  • Experience with GMP cleaning procedures.

  • Experience working in ISO 14644 classified cleanrooms.

  • Knowledge of contamination control procedures.

  • Experience with cleaning of technical installations and sensitive equipment.

  • Experience working in live construction or commissioning environments.

  • Experience operating industrial cleaning machinery.

  • Experience operating telehandlers, forklifts or similar heavy equipment.

  • Valid Category B driving licence.

  • Ability to obtain security clearance.

Language Requirements

Communication

Daily communication on site is conducted primarily in English. Applicants must therefore be able to understand work instructions, safety procedures and site documentation in English.

Additional language skills are considered an advantage when working in international teams.

Personal Profile

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • Excellent attention to detail.

  • Strong quality awareness.

  • Ability to work independently.

  • Professional attitude towards safety and compliance.

  • Flexibility regarding working hours.

  • Ability to work within multinational teams.

We Offer

  • Permanent employment in Denmark.

  • Competitive salary based on experience.

  • Long-term projects within the pharmaceutical and hyperscale data centre sectors.

  • Continuous training and professional development.

  • Opportunity to work on some of Europe's most advanced technical facilities.

title: Linen Porter, Daytime: 11:00-16:30 (15-20 hours/week) ** CAN BE COMBINED WITH ANOTHER JOB **

title: Director Sales and Key accounts
description:
You already know the maritime industry. You know who makes the decisions, why change takes time and why a trusted relationship matters more than a polished sales pitch.

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We are looking for a Global Key Account Director to join our Commercial team. Our people are our greatest assets and the driving force behind our mission, which is to enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’.

We don't just digitalize procurement. We make it smarter. By combining marketplace reach with procurement intelligence, we help shipping companies, ship managers, caterers and suppliers make better purchasing decisions through data-driven insights, recommendations and intelligent procurement tools. We create value beyond the individual transaction, enabling buyers to gain greater visibility and control over spend while helping suppliers grow through digital collaboration.

Source2Sea is part of Wrist Group, the world leader in the field of procuring and delivering supplies to the maritime industry with a turnover in 2024 of more than DKK 5.7 billion.

Reporting to our CEO, you will become part of a strong and exciting commercial team. The position is based in Copenhagen.

Summary

The successful candidate will have excellent door opening skills at highest level in the industry - either through own network, via contacts or by creating an appealing proposition which begins a meaningful communication.

You are motivated by building B2B relationships – challenging customers to rethink how maritime procurement can create greater value through digitalization and data. Through active listening and strong problem solving skills, you are able toprobe and understand the customers pain points and opportunities, and can unlock these in a tangible way.

We expect you to have a “digital-first” mindset and to be the driving force within your area of responsibility; to build long-term partnership while managing day to day relationships.

Your primary responsibilities in this role will be:

Since Source2Sea is in high growth mode the tasks will be broad and varied and a high level of adaption to customer needs is expected. In other words you will be required to roll up your sleeves.

  • The predominant part of the role will be opening doors to shipping companies, listen and understand their business challenges and demonstrate how Source2Sea creates value through our marketplace and procurement platform.

  • Tactical planning and pipeline management to ensure a prioritized approach towards the right customers, based on their individual position, needs and likelihood to embark on the digital journey.

  • Drive customer dialog until commitment to trade on Source2Sea, while gradually looping in the Customer Success team, who will handle the onboarding process and experience.

  • Bring strategic customer insights back into Product, Customer Success and Leadership to help shape the continued development of the Source2Sea platform.

  • Create and maintain sales/account plans for target clients (forecasting, planning, budget management, follow-ups, etc.).

  • Together with the commercial team you will be planning and aligning buyer pipeline category and geographical needs with matching supplier pipeline.

We are looking for these Qualifications & Requirements:

  • A “digital-first” mindset, with the ability to see and sell the benefits of being digital.

  • Door opener and relationship builder, with a documented network with the ability to engage senior executives through a consultative, value-driven sales approach.

  • Minimum 7 years of sales experience at management level.

  • Experience in the maritime industry - from either Shipowner, Ship Manager, Supplier or Service Provider.

  • Active listener with strong problem solving skills.

  • Curiosity – it is not enough to ask "What?”. You want to know “Why?”

  • Ability to travel min. 7 days / month is expected.

In return we offer:

  • A combination of a financially robust enterprise that also offers a scale-up approach.

  • The opportunity to shape the future of maritime procurement.

  • Cutting edge use of technology incl. AI, driving efficiency and a unique customer experience – with a documented strong Net Promotor Score.

  • A modern, agile and forward-looking scale-up without legacy constraints.

  • An international team – currently 7 locations and +10 nationalities.

  • Highly digital and maritime-skilled colleagues to learn from.

  • A combination of working from home and at the office.

  • A professional and challenging job in a global company with an ambitious growth strategy.

  • High impact on own role with great personal development and growth opportunities.

  • The salary and benefits will correspond to your qualifications and results.

Visit www.source2sea.com or our LinkedIn profile to learn more about our great digital scale-up.

About Source2Sea

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’ across provisions, stores, spare parts and other vessel supplies through structured digital catalogues, intelligent procurement tools, actionable insights and recommendations.

By connecting shipping companies, ship managers and caterers with a global network of maritime suppliers, Source2Sea creates value beyond the individual transaction. The marketplace provides global supplier reach, greater choice and structured digital catalogues, while the platform transforms the maritime industry's strongest data foundation into greater spend visibility, smarter purchasing decisions, increased automation and more efficient supplier collaboration and growth.

Developed in close collaboration with leading shipping companies and suppliers, Source2Sea already supports global customers at scale and continues to expand its international supplier network and platform capabilities.

Source2Sea is an independent company founded and funded by Wrist Group, the global leader in marine supply and logistics. The venture was established in collaboration with BCG X in 2021 and is headquartered at Woods Augusthus in Copenhagen.

title: Sanitør til skadeservice | bliv en del af Ocab Sjælland
description:
Hos Ocab hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder videre efter brand-, vand- og skimmelskader. Vi søger nu en sanitør, der har lyst til en hverdag med ansvar, faglige udfordringer og et stærkt fællesskab.
 
Som en del af vores team bliver du en vigtig brik i arbejdet med at begrænse skader og hjælpe kunderne godt videre. Vi ved, at en hurtig og professionel indsats kan gøre en stor forskel – både for bygninger og for de mennesker, der bliver berørt.


Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab får du en alsidig hverdag med opgaver hos både private kunder, virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber. Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger, men får også et stort selvstændigt ansvar i de enkelte opgaver.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok – uanset om opgaven er stor eller lille.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med vandskader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Deltagelse i vores døgnvagtsordning

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere om den bedste løsning for kunden

Derudover kan du også komme til at arbejde med

  • Asbestsanering

  • Sanering efter skadedyr

  • Rengøring og sanering efter brandskader

  • Oprydning og rengøring i forbindelse med socialsager

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager ansvar og møder dine kolleger og kunder med en positiv indstilling.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra skadeservice eller lignende branche – erfaring med skadeservice er en fordel

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering (en fordel, men ikke et krav)

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde

  • Er fleksibel og trives i en hverdag, hvor planerne kan ændre sig

  • Er en god holdspiller, som bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • Bor på Sjælland, så du har en rimelig afstand til de opgaver, du bliver tilknyttet

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Vi lægger stor vægt på både dine faglige kompetencer og dine menneskelige kvaliteter. Derfor opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen – uanset baggrund, køn eller erfaring.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Hver dag hjælper vi private, virksomheder og offentlige kunder med at begrænse skader og genetablere bygninger efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader.

Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed, moderne udstyr og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag

  • Dygtige kolleger og et stærkt sammenhold

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Normal arbejdstid mandag-fredag kl. 07.00-15.00

  • Deltagelse i døgnvagtsordning

Arbejdssted: Sjælland

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette
kandidat.


Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakt driftsleder Stefan Nissen på + tlf. +45 25 10 16 42.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ocab.dk


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Vi mangler vi den helt særlige brik, der får vores billede til at fuldendes
description:
Forestil dig et puslespil, hvor hver enkelt brik med dets unikke farve, form og betydning er med til at danne et stort levende billede. Det billede er Børnehuset Bækkegården. 

Her sidder leg og latter i, mellem og på væggene, og små fødder sætter dagligt spor i sandkassen og smil på vores læber. Vi er et farverigt fællesskab af børn og voksne, der hver dag lægger brikkerne til et levende billede fuld af leg, tryghed og udforskning. Hos os er legen ikke blot børnenes, den er også vores. Vi gør en dyd ud af at tage ansvar for både den frie leg og den voksenunderstøttede leg. Nogle gange går vi foran og viser vejen, andre gange går vi ved siden af, og nogle gange støtter vi kærligt bagfra – alt efter hvad det enkelte øjeblik kalder på. Vi ved, at børns relationer, mod og engagement opstår og udvikler sig i den trygge og udforskende hverdag, vi skaber for dem. 

Det relationelle arbejde er ikke bare noget, vi gør. Det er vores pædagogiske håndværk, og det har betydning, hvordan vi taler, er til stede, og hvordan vi forstår børnenes intentioner. Lige nu mangler vi en helt central brik til vores vuggestuegruppe med de mindste børn fra 0-2 år, hvor vi søger en pædagog med orden i sin relationelle værktøjskasse. Måske er du dén brik? 

Lige nu er vi 8 børn på stuen, men skal modtage flere børn i efteråret og søger derfor den sidste voksenbrik til at fuldende vores dejlige stue.

Vi har plads til dig, der elsker at være tæt på de magiske hverdagsøjeblikke. Dig, der finder stor værdi i at pusle om det enkelte barn, og som jubler med, når barnet gør sig de første erfaringer med at spise selv. Hos os samles vi om titte-bøh, trillende bolde og stabeltårnet, der væltes med frydefuld energi igen og igen og igen. Det er her, vi mærker vores faglige stolthed over arbejdet med de mindste vuggestuebørn. Vi håber, at du gør det samme.

Puslespil kræver tålmodighed, og motiverne kan drille. Sådan er det også i hverdagen. Hos os står du ikke alene – vi hjælper hinanden med at finde vejen, når noget driller, og vi udvikler os sammen som et samlet hold. 

Et levende puslespil kan ikke beskrives fuldt ud på skrift – det skal opleves, mærkes og leves. Derfor vil vi utrolig gerne invitere dig forbi til en kop kaffe og en rundvisning, så du med egne øjne kan se vores farvefulde billede. 

Vi er nysgerrige på dig: Hvad bringer du med i din pædagogiske værktøjskasse, og hvordan vil du udfylde den manglende brik i vores puslespil? 

Vi glæder os helt vildt til at høre fra dig!

 

 

I Egedal Kommune er der plads til det hele menneske

Som ansat i Egedal Kommune skal der både være plads til det gode arbejdsliv og det gode privatliv. Det kalder vi ”Den fleksible arbejdsplads”. Med den fleksible arbejdsplads skaber vi de bedst mulige rammer for medarbejdere og ledere. Vi tror nemlig på, at der skal være mulighed for at tilpasse sit arbejdsliv til sin konkrete livssituation. Det gør vi, fordi vi tror på, at medarbejdere som oplever sammenhæng i hverdagen, skaber gode resultater for vores borgere i kommunen. I Egedal findes der ikke én enkelt løsning for fleksibilitet, det afhænger nemlig både af den konkrete stilling og af den konkrete livssituation.

Egedal Kommune har cirka 45.000 indbyggere og 3.800 medarbejdere. Vi er organiseret med en direktion, seks fagcentre og to tværgående servicecentre. I Egedal Kommune lægger vi generel vægt på helhedsorienteret tænkning og tværgående samarbejde præget af dialog, anerkendelse og tillid. Vi er også en arbejdsplads, som tør gå nye veje med tætte og tværgående samarbejder under temaet ”Fælles om opgaven”. Vi finder det naturligt at samarbejde om opgaver, der ligger i mellem og på tværs af organisatoriske søjler og hierarkier. Egedal Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestilling og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge, uanset alder, køn, religion, handicap eller etnisk baggrund. Læs mere om os på EgedalKommune.dk

Der indhentes børne-og straffeattest.

title: Supply Chain Consultant, Central Jutland, Denmark
description:
Six months in Delhi. A career without borders.
Are you ready to take your next career move? This opportunity will take you into the international world of fashion and textile business.Our client is a well-established Scandinavian private label and sourcing company with more than fifteen years of experience serving leading European fashion brands. From its headquarters in Denmark, supported by international sourcing and production teams across Asia and Europe, the business has built a reputation for reliability, long-term partnerships and responsible growth. Today, the company is financially strong, highly respected within the industry and entering an ambitious new phase of international expansion.Having successfully developed a mature sourcing platform in China, the next strategic step is India.

To support that journey, we are looking for an internationally minded Supply Chain Consultant who wants far more than another supply chain position.

A role that starts with an adventure... and becomes a career.
For the first six months, you will be based in Delhi. Not simply visiting suppliers. Not attending occasional meetings. But becoming part of the local organisation, working alongside experienced colleagues and helping establish the processes, collaboration and operational excellence that will support the company's future growth in India.You will experience the business from the inside, build relationships across cultures and gain an understanding of international sourcing that few professionals acquire this early in their careers.When first step og your assignment is complete, you will return to Denmark, continuing in an international position with regular travel between Europe and India, helping connect people, ideas and operations across continents. This is not a temporary assignment. It is the beginning of a long-term international career.

More than supply chain.
You will work with sourcing, production, governance, quality and operational processes. But your real contribution will be something much bigger. You will help transfer proven ways of working into a growing international organisation. You will build relationships between colleagues from different cultures. You will support local teams, develop new ways of working and help ensure that ambitious growth is matched by consistent execution. Success in this role will depend just as much on your ability to earn trust as your ability to optimise processes.

Who are you?
Perhaps you are already working as a Buyer, Merchandiser, Production Coordinator, Supply Chain Specialist or Sourcing Consultant within fashion, textiles or consumer goods.You have developed a solid commercial understanding of production and supply chain and now find yourself looking for something larger than the next promotion. You enjoy responsibility. You are naturally curious. You communicate confidently with people from different cultures. You don't mind leaving your comfort zone if it means accelerating your professional development.And while many people talk about wanting an international career, you are genuinely prepared to live it.Previous experience working with suppliers in India would be highly valued, although your attitude, curiosity and ability to build relationships will be equally important.

Why this opportunity stands out
Few organisations can offer the combination of stability and adventure that this role provides.You will join a profitable, well-established international company with an experienced leadership team, an ambitious growth strategy and a genuine commitment to developing its people.During your assignment in Delhi, accommodation and practical support will be provided, allowing you to focus on the experience itself rather than the logistics. This also means that you will have a driver available, as well as help in the household.More importantly, you will gain something that cannot easily be taught in a classroom or acquired through occasional business travel; international credibility, cross-cultural leadership experience, and the confidence that comes from helping build an organisation across borders.

Interested?
If you are looking for a career that combines international experience, meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to influence how an ambitious organisation grows, we would very much like to hear from you.We make it easy for you, so no written application is necessary. We simply ask you to register with your CV. Your interest will be handled with utmost discretion.

title: Ressorucepædagog til Mælkevejen
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe et børnemiljø, hvor alle børn kan lykkes med dem, de er?
Vi søger en engageret og fagligt stærk ressourcepædagog, der brænder for at skabe gode rammer for børns trivsel, udvikling og deltagelse i fællesskabet.

Om Mælkevejen 
I Mælkevejen tror vi på, at alle børn kommer med unikke ressourcer, personligheder og måder at være i verden på. Vores opgave som voksne er at skabe et trygt og udviklende børnemiljø, hvor børn oplever sig set, forstået og betydningsfulde – og hvor der er plads til forskellighed.

Vi arbejder målrettet med at skabe inkluderende fællesskaber, hvor alle børn får mulighed for at lykkes med dem, de er. Det gør vi ved at arbejde med sensitive samspil og meningsfulde fællesskaber, hvor de voksne tager ansvar for at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn.

Vores pædagogiske tilgang bygger på ICDP (International Child Development Programme), hvor relationen mellem barn og voksen er fundamentet for barnets trivsel, udvikling og læring. Vi møder børnene med nysgerrighed, anerkendelse og et ressourceorienteret børnesyn og arbejder ud fra en forståelse af, at det er de voksnes ansvar at justere rammerne og skabe de bedste muligheder for, at alle børn kan være en del af fællesskabet.

Vi har fokus på tidlig indsats og på at opdage og handle på børns behov i tæt samarbejde med kolleger, forældre og tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere. Samtidig ved vi, at det gode børneliv også skabes gennem leg, varme, humor, nysgerrighed og voksne, der kan begejstres sammen med børnene.

Om stillingen
Som ressourcepædagog er du tilknyttet hele Mælkevejen og arbejder på tværs af alle stuer. Du bliver en central faglig ressource, der understøtter både børn, medarbejdere og læringsmiljøer gennem sparring, vejledning og målrettede pædagogiske indsatser.

Du har ikke ansvaret for en fast børnegruppe, men bevæger dig derhen, hvor behovet er størst. Din opgave er at understøtte den pædagogiske kvalitet i hele huset og bidrage til, at alle børn får de bedste muligheder for at trives, udvikle sig og deltage aktivt i fællesskabet.

Du har en afgørende rolle i arbejdet med tidlig indsats og inkluderende læringsmiljøer. Du omsætter pædagogisk og specialpædagogisk viden til praksis og understøtter kolleger gennem faglig sparring, refleksion og vejledning. Samtidig er du med til at sikre, at indsatser bliver systematiske, sammenhængende og forankret i den daglige praksis.

Vi har allerede en dygtig og erfaren ressourcepædagog i Mælkevejen, som du vil komme til at indgå i et tæt og forpligtende samarbejde med. Sammen vil I være med til at styrke den fælles pædagogiske retning, dele viden og understøtte udviklingen af inkluderende læringsmiljøer i hele børnehaven. 
I bliver faglige sparringspartnere for hinanden og får mulighed for at kvalificere indsatser, reflektere over praksis og sammen skabe endnu stærkere rammer for børnenes trivsel og udvikling.

Som ressourcepædagog er du en synlig og tillidsvækkende fagperson, der går foran i udviklingen af den pædagogiske praksis. Du evner at skabe følgeskab gennem stærke relationer, tydelig kommunikation og en anerkendende tilgang til dine kolleger. Du inspirerer ikke ved at have alle svarene, men ved at være nysgerrig, reflekterende og ved at omsætte faglig viden til handling i hverdagen.

Du har mod til at tage initiativ og sætte retning, også når hverdagen er kompleks, eller når situationer kalder på hurtige faglige vurderinger. Du kan bevare roen, skabe overblik og understøtte kolleger i at finde fælles løsninger, når et barn eller en børnegruppe udfordrer den pædagogiske praksis. Du tør gå forrest, facilitere faglige refleksioner og bidrage med nye perspektiver – altid med respekt for dine kollegers erfaringer og med fokus på at skabe et fælles fagligt fundament.

Humor, ro og et positivt mindset i en kompleks hverdag
Vi arbejder i en hverdag med højt tempo, mange forskellige behov og komplekse pædagogiske problemstillinger, hvor opgaverne ofte kræver både faglighed, fleksibilitet og evnen til at bevare overblikket.

Som ressourcepædagog er det afgørende, at du kan møde en omskiftelig hverdag med ro, nysgerrighed og en tro på, at der findes muligheder og løsninger – også når situationerne er krævende. Du skal kunne skabe tryghed omkring dig, bidrage til en positiv stemning og hjælpe med at finde retning, når kompleksiteten bliver stor.

Et smil, et grin og evnen til at kunne se muligheder sammen med kollegerne er med til at skabe energi og arbejdsglæde – og samtidig styrke vores evne til at lykkes med den vigtige opgave, vi har omkring børnene.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Understøtte udviklingen af inkluderende læringsmiljøer på tværs af Mælkevejen.
  • Bidrage til tidlig opsporing og forebyggende indsatser.
  • Vejlede og sparre med kolleger om pædagogiske strategier, relationer, struktur og deltagelsesmuligheder.
  • Gå foran i den pædagogiske praksis og være et fagligt forbillede, der omsætter viden til handling.
  • Facilitere faglige refleksioner og bidrage til udviklingen af en fælles pædagogisk retning.
  • Tage lederskab i komplekse pædagogiske situationer og understøtte kolleger i at skabe ro, overblik og handlemuligheder.
  • Indgå i målrettede pædagogiske forløb med børn og børnegrupper, når der er behov.
  • Bidrage til dokumentation, evaluering og opfølgning på indsatser.
  • Samarbejde tæt med ledelsen om udviklingen af den pædagogiske kvalitet.
  • Indgå i et anerkendende samarbejde med forældre.
  • Deltage aktivt i det tværfaglige samarbejde med blandt andet PPR, tale-hørekonsulent, ergoterapeut, fysioterapeut og psykolog.
  • Bidrage til videndeling og kompetenceudvikling blandt medarbejderne.

Vi søger en ressorucepædagog som

  • Er uddannet pædagog - gerne med erfaring indenfor børn og familier i udsatte positioner 
  • Har erfaring med eller stor interesse for inkluderende pædagogik, tidlig indsats og specialpædagogiske tilgange.
  • Har kendskab til eller interesse for at arbejde ud fra ICDP.
  • Kan skabe følgeskab og motivere kolleger gennem faglighed, tillid og stærke relationer.
  • Har mod til at tage lederskab i komplekse pædagogiske situationer og bidrager til at skabe ro, retning og fælles løsninger.
  • Trives med at facilitere faglige refleksioner og udviklingsprocesser tæt på praksis.
  • Kan balancere en vejledende rolle med et tæt og ligeværdigt samarbejde med kolleger.
  • Er tydelig, handlekraftig og vedholdende, samtidig med at du møder andre med nysgerrighed, respekt og ydmyghed.
  • Har et positivt mindset og kan bevare roen i komplekse situationer
  • Har stærke relationskompetencer og kan skabe tillid hos både børn, kolleger og forældre.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende funktion med stor mulighed for at præge den pædagogiske udvikling i hele Mælkevejen.
  • En central rolle som kulturbærer og sparringspartner for kolleger og ledelse.
  • En arbejdsplads hvor ICDP danner den fælles pædagogiske referenceramme.
  • Gode muligheder for tværfaglig sparring med blandt andet PPR og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere.
  • Et engageret kollegafællesskab med fokus på refleksion, videndeling og fælles udvikling.
  • En ledelse, der prioriterer nærvær, udvikling og høj kvalitet i den pædagogiske praksis.
  • Et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø med høj grad af tillid, hvor du får mulighed for selvstændigt at rammesætte og strukturere dine arbejdsopgaver 

 

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er på 35-37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 16. August 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Linda Hosseini Garmi, Pædagogisk Leder, på 28920824/29450603 eller via mail linda.garmi@glostrup.dk.
Det anbefales at sende en sms, hvis ikke det er muligt at komme igennem telefonisk.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og til at byde en ny ressourcepædagog velkommen i Mælkevejen.

title: Hotelportier for Boutique Hotel Herman K
description:
Portier

We are looking for a professional, courteous, and service-oriented Portier who is passionate about hospitality and creating exceptional guest experiences for our Boutique Hotel in the heart of Copenhagen. As one of the first and last team members our guests encounter, you play a vital role in ensuring every arrival and departure leaves a lasting impression.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys being active throughout the day, and takes pride in delivering service with attention to detail. You are approachable, proactive, and professional, with the ability to remain calm and organized even during busy periods.

As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the daily operation of a luxury 5-star boutique hotel while working alongside dedicated colleagues who share a passion for excellence, teamwork, and genuine hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome guests warmly upon arrival and wish them a memorable farewell upon departure.

  • Assist guests with luggage to and from their rooms.

  • Support the Front Office team with arrivals, departures, and ensuring a seamless check-in experience.

  • Open doors and escort guests throughout the hotel when needed.

  • Provide information about the hotel, its facilities, and local attractions.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming entrance, lobby, and surrounding guest areas.

  • Coordinate with Hosts, Housekeeping, and other departments to deliver a seamless guest experience.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to guest requests with discretion and attention to detail.

  • Assist with luggage storage, deliveries, and other operational tasks as required.

  • Help create a warm, welcoming atmosphere that reflects the hotel's high service standards.

What We Offer

  • A key role in creating memorable first and last impressions for our guests.

  • The opportunity to work in a prestigious luxury 5-star boutique hotel.

  • A varied and dynamic working day with guests from around the world.

  • A supportive and professional team environment where collaboration, hospitality, and respect are at the heart of everything we do.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional development through training, coaching, and continuous learning.

  • A workplace with high ambitions, short decision-making processes, and the freedom to take responsibility.

  • Competitive salary and attractive employee benefits.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in hospitality, customer service, or a guest-facing role is an advantage, but not essential.

  • You are friendly, approachable, and genuinely enjoy creating great guest experiences.

  • You work in a structured and reliable manner while taking responsibility for your tasks.

  • You communicate confidently and professionally in English; additional languages are an advantage.

  • You remain calm under pressure and can maintain a positive attitude during busy periods.

  • You are proactive, solution-oriented, and enjoy working as part of a team.

  • You have excellent attention to detail and take pride in maintaining high standards.

  • You are flexible and comfortable working evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required.

  • If the role includes valet parking, a valid driver's license is an advantage but not required for all candidates.

If you are passionate about luxury hospitality and take pride in creating unforgettable guest experiences, we would love to hear from you.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application no later than 15 August 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Zeljka Stefanic Urbina at teamlead@hermank.dk. Please include "Portier" in the subject line of your email.

Part of Bühlmann Hotels

Bühlmann Hotels is home to a collection of unique hotels across Denmark, ranging from vibrant city hotels to iconic boutique properties. While each hotel has its own distinctive character, we are united by a shared commitment to exceptional hospitality and the values that define our culture: care, flexibility, presence, passion, and respect for people and the environment.

Learn more about our hotels at www.buhlmann.dk.

title: Studentermedhjælper til Idræt og Folkeoplysning med fokus på Herlevpasset
description:
For dig, som brænder for børn og unges deltagelse i foreningslivet - og kan opbygge stærke samarbejder.

Trives du med at opbygge nye strukturer, og får du energi af at skabe tværgående samarbejder, der gør en konkret forskel for børn og unge? Så har vi et spændende studiejob, der måske lige er noget for dig.

Idræt og Folkeoplysning søger en engageret studentermedhjælper til at varetage, implementere, udvikle og synliggøre Herlevpasset, som er et nyt initiativ, der skal give udsatte børn og unge bedre mulighed for at deltage i fritids- og foreningsaktiviteter gennem støtte til kontingent.

Organisationen

Du bliver en del af Idræt og Folkeoplysning, som er en afdeling med mange forskellige fagligheder, og som arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af opgaver. Din faste base bliver i administrationsteamet, som holder til i Skinderskovhallen. Vi arbejder med alt fra politiske sager, foreningsvejledning og tilskudsadministration til events, aktivitets- og facilitetsudvikling. Derudover rummer afdelingen livredderne i Hjortespringbadet og et driftsteam, som sørger for de mange forskellige idræts- og fritidsfaciliteter, vi har i Herlev Kommune. 

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Du bliver en vigtig del af hverdagen og udviklingen af Herlevpasset og kommer bl.a. til at:

  • Varetage administration, understøttelse og synliggørelse af Herlevpasset. 
  • Stå for kommunikation og udbredelsen af Herlevpasset i samarbejde med skoler, institutioner og foreningslivet.
  • Være med til at opbygge det tværgående samarbejde med skoler og institutioner.
  • Understøtte koordineringen mellem skoler og foreningsliv. 
  • Følge op med foreningerne og fungere som følgefunktion i forbindelse med enkelte børns opstart og fastholdelse i fritidsaktiviteter. 
  • Indsamle erfaringer og data om Herlevpasset samt udarbejde evalueringer og status til løbende at optimere ordningen.
Om stillingen
  • Stillingen er på gennemsnitligt 12 timer om ugen. 
  • Vi tilbyder fleksibel arbejdstid – der er en forventning om, at du kan være struktureret i forhold til at planlægge egne opgaver og tid.
Om dig 

Det er et krav, at du er studerende på en videregående uddannelse. Derudover forestiller vi os, at du: 

  • Er serviceminded, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst. 
  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre. 
  • Har mod på at tage ejerskab for Herlev Passet og kan opbygge gode relationer til mange forskellige samarbejdspartnere.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
  • Stillingen ønskes besat med start den 1. september 2026.
  • Ansættelsesperioden er tidsbegrænset til den 31. december 2027, med mulighed for forlængelse.
  • Løn fastsættes i henhold til gældende HK overenskomst for studentermedhjælpere og aftales efter principperne om ny løn. Det konkrete lønudspil oplyses i forbindelse med en eventuel samtale.
  • Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest.
  • Herlev Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.
Få mere at vide

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Idræts- og Fritidschef Anders Friese Hørberg telefon 21 79 61 24.

Ansøgningsfrist og samtaler

Ansøgningsfristen er den 14. august 2026, kl. 12:00. Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt den 25. august.

Mød vores medarbejdere

På herlev.dk kan du møde nogle af vores medarbejdere fra forskellige arbejdspladser i kommunen. De fortæller hver især om, hvad de arbejder med, og hvorfor de er glade for deres arbejde.

Søg stillingen

Du søger stillingen online. Husk at vedhæfte din ansøgning, CV og andre relevante bilag. Når du har sendt ansøgningen, modtager du en e-mail som kvittering. Vær opmærksom på, at mailen kan være placeret i din mappe ”Spam/uønsket post”.

 
Om Herlev

Herlev er placeret i hjertet af hovedstadsområdet med en velfungerende infrastruktur. Transportmulighederne til og fra Herlev er gode og bliver forstærket med den kommende letbane og de fire letbanestationer i byen. Samtidig byder Herlev på let adgang til grønne områder. Vi er i fuld gang med at udvikle byen, så den også i fremtiden har et levende handelsliv, en spændende bymidte og er attraktiv at bo og drive virksomhed i.

I Herlev Kommune arbejder vi ambitiøst og målrettet på at sikre, at vores tilbud til borgerne også i fremtiden er på et højt niveau. Det gør vi ved at indrette organisationen med et større fokus på at styrke fagligheden og understøtte dialogen med borgerne, samt forkorte afstanden mellem det lokale politiske niveau og kommunens medarbejdere.

title: MultifunC søger pædagogisk dagmedarbejder - skab tryghed og stabilitet for udsatte unge
description:
Er det vigtigt for dig, at du arbejder et sted, hvor du kan gøre en forskel? Har du lyst til at udvikle dine faglige kompetencer i et job, der udfordrer dig hver dag?

”Det er meget tilfredsstillende at hjælpe unge mennesker i en svær periode. MultifunC har rammerne, fagligheden og kollegerne til at gøre det til et rigtig spændende og meningsfuldt job for dig” oplyser områdechef Julie Lund. 

Velkommen til DOK
Specialområde Kriminalitetstruede og Dømte Børn og Unge (DOK) er en del af Socialområdet i Region Midtjylland. DOK består af behandlingsinstitutionerne: Grenen-Glesborg, Grenen-Dalstrup, Koglen og MultifunC.

I DOK arbejder vi ud fra et fælles menneskesyn som den grundlæggende måde vi ser og møder mennesker på. Vores menneskesyn er retningsgivende for vores handlinger, relationer og faglige beslutninger og det skal kunne mærkes i måden hvorpå vi; -taler med, til og om mennesker, -samarbejder, -udøver ledelse og -tilrettelægger vores pædagogiske og behandlingsmæssige praksis. 

Vores fire grundlæggende værdier er: 

  1. Ligeværd - alle mennesker har værdi og skal mødes ligeværdigt
  2. Selv - og medbestemmelse - alle mennesker har ret til indflydelse på eget liv
  3. Respekt - alle mennesker skal mødes med respekt for deres historie, erfaringer, perspektiver og grænser
  4. Udviklingspotentiale - alle mennesker har potentiale for udvikling

Vores pædagogiske praksis bygger på tre elementer:

  1. Omsorgsfulde relationer da de er afgørende for tryghed, trivsel og udvikling
  2. Anerkendende tilgang da det handler om at møde de unge med nysgerrighed, respekt og forståelse
  3. Struktur da det skaber forudsigelighed, tydelighed og tryghed, men strukturen må aldrig stå i vejen for den individuelle vurdering

Hvad er MultifunC?

MultifunC er en delvis lukket behandlingsinstitution med op til 10 børn og unge, der ofte har erfaringer med ustabile opvækstvilkår, mistrivsel, belastende livserfaringer og sporadisk tilknytning til positive fællesskaber.

De unge kan være anbragt efter lov om bekæmpelse af ungdomskriminalitet, retsplejeloven §765 (varetægt), straffeloven §74a (ungdomssanktion), lov om fuldbyrdelse af straf §78 (alternativ afsoning), og udlændingelovens § 36 og hjemrejselovens § 16.

Der arbejdes ud fra et manualbaseret behandlingskoncept, der løbende er tilpasset til dansk praksis og baserer sig på blandt andet adfærdspsykologiske og kognitive metoder.

Behandlingen tager udgangspunkt i den systemiske referenceramme, hvor der arbejdes med den unge, uddannelse, familien og fritid. Institutionen består derfor af fire teams: et psykologteam, et skoleteam, et familieteam og et pædagogteam. Hvert team varetager fagspecifikke funktioner i forhold til den samlede behandlingsindsats. Formålet med denne behandling er at reducere den unges samlede risiko for en fortsat negativ udvikling. 

Hvad søger vi?

Som pædagogisk dagmedarbejder bliver du en central del af den daglige behandlingsindsats omkring de unge. Du skal skabe trygge og udviklende relationer, samtidig med, at du arbejder struktureret, konsekvent og professionelt i en delvis lukket ramme. 

Du vil blandt andet: 

  • Indgå i den daglige pædagogiske og behandlingsmæssige indsats omkring de unge. 
  • Arbejde målrettet med behandlingsplaner og individuelle udviklingsmål.
  • Bidrage til et trygt og struktureret miljø med tydelige rammer. 
  • Understøtte behandlingskomponenter ART og MOVE.
  • Anvende MI (Motiverende interview) med en bevidst tilgang ud fra KAT (Kognitiv adfærdsterapi)
  • Dokumentere indsatsen løbende i Sensum One.
  • Varetage medicinhåndtering, herunder dispensering og dokumentation. 
  • Deltage i tværfaglige møder og koordinere indsatser med institutionens øvrige faggrupper. 
  • Samarbejde med pårørende, myndigheder og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. 

Vi søger en medarbejder der: 

  • Er en moden rollemodel med længere pædagogpraksis baggrund
  • Har solid erfaring med kriminalitetstruede, udsatte eller behandlingskrævende unge.
  • Har indgående kendskab til og erfaring med et manualbaserede konceptet.
  • Har erfaring med MI og KAT og kan omsætte metoderne i praksis.
  • Har erfaring med tværfagligt samarbejde og kan bidrage aktivt til fælles behandlingsmål.
  • Har erfaring medicinhåndtering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation.
  • Har erfaring med dokumentation i Sensum One.
  • Kan bevare ro, overblik og faglig refleksion i komplekse situationer.
  • Er relationsstærk, tydelig og anerkendende i mødet med de unge.
  • Har kørekort kategori B.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og et stærkt behandlingsfagligt fundament
  • Mulighed for at arbejde med en kompleks målgruppe, hvor du gør en forskel
  • Et engageret tværfagligt miljø med fokus på udvikling og sparring
  • Løbende supervision, kompetenceudvikling og faglig opkvalificering
  • En arbejdsplads med storpolitisk bevågenhed
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor værdierne ligeværd, respekt og udviklingspotentiale omsættes til konkret praksis hver dag
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi vil hinanden
  • Et arbejdsmiljø hvor der er fokus på god normering, sikkerhed, trivsel og udvikling

Vi forventer:

At du kan se muligheder bag adfærd, arbejde relationelt og struktureret samt bidrage til at skabe udvikling for unge, som ofte har oplevet flere nederlag end succeser. 

Vil du være med til at skabe tryghed, struktur og udvikling for nogle af landets mest udsatte unge? Så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig. 

Spørgsmål: 
Kontakt leder af pædagogteamet Lisbeth Knakkergaard, 51 84 06 56 eller lisbeth.knakkergaard@social.rm.dk

Samtaler forventes afholdt torsdag 6. august.
Tiltrædelse 1. oktober eller efter nærmere aftale. Du kan læse mere på dok.rm.dk.

Ansøgningsfrist: 31. juli.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår  
Stillingen er omfattet af lokalløn. Løn- og ansættelsesforhold efter gældende overenskomst.
Der indhentes straffeattest, og det forudsættes, at du kan godkendes til arbejdet på baggrund af din straffeattest.    

Din arbejdsplads vil primært være på MultifunC, Damagervej 26A, 8260 Viby J. Der må forventes kurser og lignede på vores andre matrikler.  
 

 

 

 

 

 

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Erfaren Sushikok søges til Enso Izakaya i Fredensborg / Experienced and responsible Sushi Chef
description:

Enso Izakaya er en japansk restaurant i hjertet af Fredensborg. Vi serverer frisk sushi og japanske retter med fokus på kvalitet, gode råvarer og en god oplevelse for vores gæster.

3480 Fredensborg

About Us

Enso Izakaya is a Japanese restaurant located in the heart of Fredensborg. We serve fresh sushi and authentic Japanese dishes, with a strong focus on quality, fresh ingredients, and providing an excellent dining experience for our guests.

We are looking for an experienced and responsible Sushi Chef who is passionate about Japanese cuisine and would like to become an important part of our team while contributing to the growth and development of our restaurant.

  • Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing sushi, sashimi, nigiri, maki, and other Japanese dishes.

  • Daily preparation of fresh ingredients.

  • Maintaining consistent high quality in all dishes.

  • Ensuring compliance with food safety, hygiene regulations, and internal food control procedures.

  • Managing inventory and ordering ingredients.

  • Reducing food waste and optimizing ingredient usage.

  • Contributing to the development and improvement of the menu.

  • Creating new sushi dishes and hot Japanese dishes.

  • Planning and organizing daily kitchen operations.

  • Working closely with the rest of the restaurant team.

  • Training new employees when required.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has previous experience as a Sushi Chef.

  • Can work independently.

  • Is responsible, organized, and detail-oriented.

  • Has experience with food safety and kitchen hygiene.

  • Is flexible and available to work both weekdays and weekends.

  • Works well as part of a team.

  • Can communicate in English.

  • Knowledge of Chinese is an advantage, but not required.

We Offer

  • Flexible working hours.

  • The opportunity to contribute to menu development and leave your own mark on the restaurant.

  • A growing restaurant with opportunities for personal and professional development.

Enso Izakaya

3480 Fredensborg, Denmark
