title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

description:

Les conditions
- CDI
- Temps plein
- Répartition sur 5 ou 6 jours
- 38 heures par semaine

La structure
Vous rejoindrez un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire implanté à Rogliano, à proximité de Cosenza, en Calabre. L'établissement est spécialisé dans le diagnostic, le traitement, la prévention et la réadaptation, avec une prise en charge personnalisée reposant sur des technologies modernes et une équipe multidisciplinaire. En outre, le service de médecine physique et de réadaptation est conventionné avec le Service national de santé italien et prend en charge les pathologies du système musculo-squelettique et du système nerveux. Les patients bénéficient d'examens d'imagerie réalisés sur place et d'un parcours de rééducation intégrant thérapies manuelles et techniques modernes.

La rémunération
- Rémunération selon la convention collective nationale italienne CCNL AIOP RSA, niveau D2

Les missions
- Prendre en charge les troubles de la communication, du langage, de la parole et de la déglutition
- Évaluer les patients et établir des bilans orthophoniques précis
- Mettre en place des programmes de rééducation personnalisés
- Collaborer avec les équipes médicales et paramédicales dans une approche multidisciplinaire
- Suivre l'évolution des patients et adapter les prises en charge
- Contribuer à la qualité et à la continuité des soins

Les avantages
- Logement pris en charge pendant les 6 premiers mois
- Accompagnement administratif pour faciliter l'installation en Italie
- Contrat à durée indéterminée proposé en priorité avec possibilités de collaboration indépendante selon profil
- Équipe pluridisciplinaire et prise en charge personnalisée des patients
- Accès à l'imagerie et aux techniques de rééducation sur site
- Aménagement du temps de travail sur 5 ou 6 jours selon l'organisation

Le petit truc en plus
Rogliano bénéficie d'un emplacement proche de Cosenza, ville universitaire et culturelle, et offre un accès rapide à la diversité des paysages de la Calabre, entre zones littorales et massifs intérieurs, pour des sorties nature et une qualité de vie agréable.

Il ruolo funge da interfaccia chiave tra magazzini, vettori, spedizionieri, doganieri, clienti interni ed esterni e stakeholder interni, assicurando la corretta esecuzione dei flussi logistici internazionali e la risoluzione dei problemi operativi. Requisiti: - Laurea triennale in Logistica, Gestione della catena di approvvigionamento, Economia aziendale, Ingegneria o settori affini. - Esperienza pregressa in logistica internazionale, trasporti o operazioni di import/export. - Esperienza nel coordinamento delle spedizioni con vettori, spedizionieri e doganieri. - Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata. - Esperienza con piattaforme ERP e TMS. title: specialista di marketing
description: Grafton Office è la specializzazione dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. For a multinational client company, a leading player in the telecommunications and ICT sector, we are recruiting: Digital Marketing specialist Main Responsibilities: - Digital Strategy & Campaign Execution: Design and execute multi-channel digital strategies (Social Media, Email, SEO, and Paid Advertising) aligned with commercial goals to drive brand visibility and lead generation. - Content Management & Optimization: Create, manage, and optimize engaging digital content for the company website and social platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, X). Ensure consistent messaging and strict adherence to SEO and brand guidelines. - Localization & Asset Creation: Lead content localization and regular website updates. Collaborate with Product Managers to develop promotional assets, including visuals, videos, and brochures tailored to professional B2B audiences. - Performance Analytics: Track and analyze campaign performance using tools such as Google Analytics and social media insights. Provide actionable reports and recommendations to drive measurable business impact. - Stakeholder & Agency Coordination: Interface with internal media teams and external agencies for high-quality content production. Support the digital promotion of product launches, webinars, and roadshows. - Integrated Marketing Support: Partner with Sales and Product teams to ensure integrated campaigns effectively support business development and customer engagement.. Requirements: - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Political Science, Visual Design, or a related field. - Language Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in Italian and English are must to facilitate collaboration between local stakeholders and Global HQ. - Experience: Minimum 1 year of proven experience in marketing, with a strong focus on digital strategy, campaign execution, and performance analysis. - Technical Skills: Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for high-quality reporting; familiar with digital analytics and social media management tools. - Work Style: Meticulous attention to detail and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and high pressure. - Mindset: Strong analytical mindset with a creative, forward-thinking approach to identifying Location: Milan Position requirement: Agency Worker, 1 year contract Salary range: 27K-32K - ticket 8 euro Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. Il nostro Gruppo è attivo nei seguenti campi: lavoro temporaneo, Permanent e Professional Staffing, Ricerca e Selezione, Consulenza HR, Formazione, Outsourcing, supporto alla ricollocazione e attività complementari. Siamo presenti in più di 30 Paesi in Europa, Asia e America con un team di oltre 6000 persone. I valori che ci contraddistinguono: attenzione, parità di genere

Disegno e implementazione di modelli dati Realizzazione di dashboard e reportistica utilizzando Power BI e tool di data visualization (Tableau, Qlik) Delineazione di approcci per la governance e implementazione di Power BI Utilizzo di piattaforme dati avanzate come Microsoft Fabric e Databricks per la gestione, modellazione e integrazione dei dati Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Luogo di lavoro: Napoli in modalità ibrida, si richiede una presenza obbligatoria di 20 giorni l'anno in sede Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! Siamo presenti in più di 37 Paesi in Europa, Asia e America con un team di oltre 8.000 persone. title: assistente alle risorse umane
description: Gi Group, una delle principali agenzie per il lavoro in Italia, per nota azienda, leader nel settore alimentare, ricerchiamo un/una: Payroll & HR Cost Controlling Specialist per gestire il processo di amministrazione del personale e paghe in collaborazione con il provider esterno. La risorsa si occuperà in particolare di Gestione end-to-end del ciclo paghe e contributi in collaborazione con payroll provider esterno. Riconciliazioni budget e verifiche mensili. Simulazioni di scenari di costo e valutazione impatti economico-finanziari. Analisi e pianificazione di schemi di turnazione complessi (ciclo continuo 7/7). Supporto nella valutazione di progetti organizzativi e loro sostenibilità economica. Interfaccia con consulente del lavoro e direzione HR. Approfondita conoscenza della normativa di riferimento, capacità di elaborare cedolini anche senza software, preferibile conoscenza CCNL Alimentare. Gradita conoscenza del software TeamSystem. Orientamento analitico, capacità di ragionamento su scenari finanziari. Precisione, riservatezza, autonomia. Full time - 40h settimanali. Contratto diretto in azienda a tempo indeterminato. Salario lordo mensile: 2000 euro - 2800 euro Sede di lavoro: Catania Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. Il nostro Gruppo è attivo nei seguenti campi: lavoro temporaneo, Permanent e Professional Staffing, Ricerca e Selezione, Consulenza HR, Formazione, Outsourcing, supporto alla ricollocazione e attività complementari. Siamo presenti in più di 30 Paesi in Europa, Asia e America con un team di oltre 6000 persone. I valori che ci contraddistinguono: attenzione, passione, apprendimento continuo e innovazione, collaborazione, sostenibilità, responsabilità. Consulta tutti i nostri annunci su www.gigroup.it

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

description: atlieka smulkius remonto darbus: keičia lemputes, spynas, čiaupų tarpines ir kitus susidėvėjusius elementus; remontuoja santechnikos įrenginius ir sistemas: keičia vamzdynų dalis, remontuoja kriaukles, klozetus, čiaupus ir kitą įrangą; atlieka patalpų apdailos darbus: dažo, glaisto, tinkuoja, klijuoja plyteles ir tapetus, taiso pažeistus paviršius; prižiūri vandentiekio ir kanalizacijos sistemas, tikrina jų techninę būklę, esant poreikiui šalina gedimus; valo ir prižiūri kanalizacijos tinklus; vykdo pastatų ir sistemų periodines apžiūras ne rečiau kaip du kartus per metus; atlieka neeilines apžiūras po nepalankių oro sąlygų (liūčių, vėjų, šalčių), tikrina pastatų konstrukcijas ir sistemas; atlieka krovimo ir pernešimo darbus laikydamasis saugos reikalavimų; pastebėjęs gedimus ar techninius pažeidimus, informuoja atsakingus asmenis ir, pagal galimybes, juos pašalina; laikosi įrengimų eksploatavimo, darbuotojų saugos ir sveikatos, priešgaisrinės saugos, elektrosaugos reikalavimų; papildomai prižiūri ir remontuoja medines konstrukcijas, baldus bei inventorių, atlieka kitus pavestus darbus.

title: Transporto specialistas (-ė)
description:
Užtikrinti techniškai tvarkingą Bendrovės transporto priemonių būklę ir jų saugų eksploatavimą.
Kontroliuoti transporto priemonių ridą, alyvų, filtrų, padangų būklę ir techninės priežiūros periodiškumą.
Organizuoti transporto priemonių techninius aptarnavimus, remontus ir technines apžiūras.
Užtikrinti savalaikį transporto priemonių civilinės atsakomybės ir KASKO draudimų pratęsimą.
Vesti transporto priemonių remonto, techninės priežiūros ir profilaktikos dokumentaciją.
Kontroliuoti racionalų medžiagų ir mechanizmų naudojimą.
Užtikrinti, kad transporto priemones eksploatuojantys darbuotojai laikytųsi saugos ir sveikatos, gaisrinės saugos bei kitų teisės aktų reikalavimų.

title: Santechnikas-remontininkas
description:
Darbo pobūdis:
*Šildymo sistemų vamzdynų montavimo, remonto ir keitimo darbai.
*Karšto ir šalto vandens tiekimo vamzdynų keitimas, remontas ir priežiūra.
*Buitinių ir lietaus nuotekų vamzdynų remonto bei keitimo darbai.
*Senų vamzdynų demontavimas ir naujų sistemų montavimas.
*Gedimų diagnostika ir jų šalinimas vidaus inžineriniuose tinkluose.
*Santechnikos įrangos montavimas, remontas ir prijungimas.
*Darbų atlikimas pagal techninius brėžinius, projektus ir galiojančius statybos bei saugos reikalavimus.
*Darbo vietos tvarkos palaikymas ir saugaus darbo reikalavimų laikymasis.

title: Elektrikas remonto komandoje
description:
Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io), kuri (-is) prisijungtų prie Šiaulių remonto komandos ir padėtų mums saugiai bei užtikrintai tiekti elektros energiją vartotojams.

Prisidėsi prie žalios ir saugios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:
Vykdant remonto ir techninės priežiūros darbus 0,4-10 kV elektros skirstomųjų tinklų įrenginiuose;
Vykdant operatyvinius perjungimus 0,4-110 kV įtampos elektros įrenginiuose;
Šalinant defektus ir gedimus 0,4-10 kV įtampos elektros įrenginiuose;
Vykdant veikiančių elektros įrenginių apžiūrą.

title: Suvirintojas (-a) - šaltkalvis (-ė)
description: Šiluminių įrenginių, šilumos tinklų, metalo konstrukcijų ir vamzdynų montavimo, pramonės įrangos priežiūros bei remonto darbų atlikimas (suvirinimas).

title: Suvirintojas
description:
Vykdyti turimos specialybės ir kvalifikacijos darbus bei darbus, kuriems atlikti užtenka jo turimos kvalifikacijos: 1. įvairių metalo gaminių gamyba ir remontas, atliekant tekinimo, frezavimo, šlifavimo, suvirinimo, sriegimo, pjovimo ir kitus šaltkalviškus detalių apdorojimo darbus; 2. įvairių katilinių bei šilumos tinklų įrengimų (siurblių, ventiliatorių, dūmsiurbių, ortakių), talpų, armatūros, garnitūros montavimas, demontavimas, remontas; 3. katilų, slėginių indų ir vamzdynų patalpose ir lauke, talpų montavimas, demontavimas, dažymas, izoliavimas bei kiti darbai iki pilno užbaigimo ir aplinkos sutvarkymo; 4. turint atitinkamą kvalifikaciją, nustatytos formos pažymėjimus, sertifikatus, metalo suvirinimo darbų vykdymas, metalo pjovimo, naudojant suskystintas dujas, darbų vykdymas, suvirinimo aparatų bei kitos suvirinimo darbams naudojamos įrangos priežiūra bei smulkaus remonto darbus; 5. miesto pastatų šildymo ir karšto vandens, vėdinimo sistemų bei šilumos punktų hidraulinių bandymų, praplovimų, šilumokaičių cheminių praplovimų, šilumos ir karšto vandens skaitiklių keitimo, vamzdynų ventilių, sklendžių, pačių vamzdynų remonto, keitimo, šiluminio izoliavimo, dažymo, žymėjimo ir kitų remonto darbų, šilumos tinklų remonto, paruošimo remonto darbams, užtikrinant patikimą ir ekonomišką jų darbą bei tinkamą techninį būvį, vykdymas; 6. žemės darbų iškasose, gilesnėse kaip l,5 m šuliniuose ir kituose statiniuose, uždarose talpyklose;
7. krovinių tvarkymo, krovimo rankomis bei smulkaus remonto darbų, kėlimo reikmenų priežiūros darbų, stropavimo darbų atlikimas; 8. Bendrovės įrengimų, miesto šildomų objektų šildymo ir karšto vandens sistemų gedimų, technologinių sutrikimų, sutrikimų, avarijų, gaisrų gesinimo, aplinkos užteršimo šalinimo darbų atlikimas.

title: Elektrikas - automatikas
description:
- savarankiškai pasirinkti darbo metodus ir spręsti iškylančias problemas;
- elektros ir automatikos sistemų supratimas, gebėjimas skaityti ir analizuoti schemas;
- PLC (programuojamų loginių valdiklių ) žinios, jų programavimas;
- pavarų, jutiklių, valdymo įrangos konfigūravimas, derinimas;
-  vykdyti elektros energijos tiekimo sistemų priežiūrą ir remontą, nustatyti ir šalinti įrangos trikdžius:
- vykdyti apšvietimo elektrinių tinklų, šviestuvų, armatūros montavimą (jungiklių, rozečių ir kt.) ir remontą;
- vykdyti elektros įrangos elektrotechninių parametrų matavimus (izoliacijos varžos tikrinimo, pereinamosios varžos, įžeminimo kontūrų varžos būklės nustatymas);
- vykdyti matavimo prietaisų komplektų tikrinimo, profilaktikos, programavimo, derinimo, remonto, gedimų šalinimo darbus;
- vykdyti automatinio reguliavimo sistemų veikimo tikrinimo, profilaktikos, derinimo, gedimų šalinimo darbus;
- šiluminės automatikos, impulsinių linijų profilaktikos, remonto, gedimų šalinimo darbus;
- gebėti skaityti techninę literatūrą anglų kalba.
- vykdyti kitas funkcijas, kurios numatytos darbo sutartyje, Lietuvos Respublikos teisės ir Bendrovės lokaliniuose norminiuose aktuose.

title: Remonto ir priežiūros specialistas
description: Mokėti savarankiškai priimti sprendimus, vykdyti turimos specialybės ir kvalifikacijos darbus, kuriems atlikti užtenka jo turimos kvalifikacijos: 1. įvairių metalo gaminių gamyba ir remontas, atliekant tekinimo, frezavimo, šlifavimo, suvirinimo, sriegimo, pjovimo ir kitus šaltkalviškus detalių apdorojimo darbus; 2. įvairių katilinių bei šilumos tinklų įrengimų (siurblių, ventiliatorių, dūmsiurbių, ortakių), talpų, armatūros, garnitūros montavimas, demontavimas, remontas; 3. katilų, slėginių indų ir vamzdynų patalpose ir lauke, talpų montavimas, demontavimas, dažymas, izoliavimas bei kiti darbai iki pilno užbaigimo ir aplinkos sutvarkymo; 4. turint atitinkamą kvalifikaciją, nustatytos formos pažymėjimus, sertifikatus, metalo suvirinimo darbų vykdymas, metalo pjovimo, naudojant suskystintas dujas, darbų vykdymas, suvirinimo aparatų bei kitos suvirinimo darbams naudojamos įrangos priežiūra bei smulkaus remonto darbus; 5. miesto pastatų šildymo ir karšto vandens, vėdinimo sistemų bei šilumos punktų hidraulinių bandymų, praplovimų, šilumokaičių cheminių praplovimų, šilumos ir karšto vandens skaitiklių keitimo, vamzdynų ventilių, sklendžių, pačių vamzdynų remonto, keitimo, šiluminio izoliavimo, dažymo, žymėjimo ir kitų remonto darbų, šilumos tinklų remonto, paruošimo remonto darbams, užtikrinant patikimą ir ekonomišką jų darbą bei tinkamą techninį būvį, vykdymas; 6. žemės darbų iškasose, gilesnėse kaip l,5 m šuliniuose ir kituose statiniuose, uždarose talpyklose; 7. krovinių tvarkymo, krovimo rankomis bei smulkaus remonto darbų, kėlimo reikmenų priežiūros darbų, stropavimo darbų atlikimas; 8. Bendrovės įrengimų, miesto šildomų objektų šildymo ir karšto vandens sistemų gedimų, technologinių sutrikimų, sutrikimų, avarijų, gaisrų gesinimo, aplinkos užteršimo šalinimo darbų atlikimas.

title: Priežiūros technikas
description:
Katilinės įrenginių priežiūra ir valdymas- katilinių įrenginių paleidimas, stabdymas, reguliavimas, degimo proceso kontrolė ir reguliavimas, smulkių einamųjų remonto bei einamųjų eksploatacijos darbų vykdymas, užtikrinant normalų įrenginių darbą pagal užduotus technologinius parametrus bei reikiamą jų techninį būvį;
- perjungimų, dalyvaujant vyresniajam priežiūros technikui, vykdymas;
- dujų reguliavimo punktų (DRP), cheminio ūkio, priežiūra, reguliavimas, smulkių remonto bei einamųjų eksploatacijos darbų vykdymas;
- tvarkos, švaros katilinių patalpose bei teritorijose palaikymo darbų vykdymas;
- įrenginių technologinių sutrikimų, sutrikimų, avarijų, gaisrų gesinimo, aplinkos užteršimo atvejų likvidavimo darbų vykdymas;
- krovinių perkėlimo, krovimo, nešimo rankomis darbai;
- chemiškai valyto vandens kokybės kontrolė, cheminio vandens valymo įrenginių darbo palaikymo bei vandens kokybės užtikrinimo darbų vykdymas;
- reikalingų materialinių vertybių, transportavimo, pakrovimo, iškrovimo, sandėliavimo darbų vykdymas;
- katilinės įrenginių ir vamzdynų izoliavimo, dažymo darbų vykdymas;
- kitų nenuolatinio pobūdžio pavedimų ir kitų pareigų, kurios numatytos darbo sutartyje, Lietuvos Respublikos teisės ir Bendrovės vidiniuose norminiuose aktuose, vykdymas.

title: Darbininkas
description:
1.   Atlieka smulkius gimnazijos pastatų, patalpų, įrenginių, baldų ir kito inventoriaus remonto darbus.
2.    Atlieka vidaus ir lauko aplinkos tvarkymo, priežiūros bei gerinimo darbus.
3.    Padeda pernešti, pakrauti, iškrauti ir sustatyti baldus, mokymo priemones, inventorių bei kitus krovinius.
4.    Montuoja, demontuoja ir perstato baldus, lentynas, stendus bei kitą įrangą pagal poreikį.
5.    Atlieka dažymo, glaistymo, sandarinimo ir kitus paprastus apdailos darbus, kuriems nereikalinga speciali kvalifikacija.
6.    Prižiūri ir remontuoja tvoras, vartelius, suoliukus, šiukšliadėžes, sporto aikštelių įrangą bei kitus lauko infrastruktūros elementus.
7.    Padeda paruošti patalpas renginiams, egzaminams, susirinkimams ir kitai gimnazijos veiklai.
8.    Prižiūri darbo įrankius, užtikrina jų tinkamą naudojimą ir saugojimą.
9.    Pastebėjęs pastatų, įrenginių ar inžinerinių sistemų gedimus, nedelsdamas informuoja direktoriaus pavaduotoją ūkiui arba kitą atsakingą asmenį.
10.    Dalyvauja sezoniniuose teritorijos priežiūros darbuose ir prisideda prie estetinės gimnazijos aplinkos palaikymo.
11.    Laikosi darbuotojų saugos ir sveikatos, priešgaisrinės saugos, civilinės saugos, higienos bei vidaus darbo tvarkos reikalavimų.
12.    Pagal kompetenciją padeda vykdyti pasirengimo ekstremaliosioms situacijoms, mobilizacijai ir civilinės saugos priemones, padeda įrengti ar parengti numatytas patalpas, perkelti reikalingą inventorių ir priemones.
13.    Racionaliai naudoja darbo priemones ir medžiagas, saugo gimnazijos turtą.
14.    Vykdo kitus vienkartinio pobūdžio darbus ir teisėtus gimnazijos direktoriaus ar direktoriaus pavaduotojo ūkiui pavedimus, susijusius su pareigybės funkcijomis.

title: Medic. įrangos priež. tarnybos vyr.specialistas
description:
svarbios techninės žinios, gebėjimas spręsti praktines problemas, atsakingas požiūris į medicinos įrangos saugą bei noras prisidėti prie sklandaus ligoninės padalinių darbo;
medicininės įrangos priežiūros tarnybos vyriausiasis specialistas (-ė) bus atsakingas (-a) už medicinos įrangos techninės priežiūros, gedimų šalinimo, remonto, smulkių remonto darbų atlikimo, profilaktinės priežiūros, medicinos įrangos apskaitos, dokumentacijos ir įrangos valdymo funkcijas pagal priskirtus ligoninės padalinius / korpusus;
organizuoti ir vykdyti medicinos įrangos priežiūros bei remonto procesus, vertinti įrangos techninę būklę, analizuoti gedimus, spręsti technines problemas, koordinuoti išorinių paslaugų teikėjų darbus, pildyti ir prižiūrėti techninę dokumentaciją bei bendradarbiauti su ligoninės padaliniais;
organizuoti ir vykdyti ligoninėje eksploatuojamos medicinos įrangos techninę priežiūrą, profilaktinės priežiūros, remonto, montavimo, derinimo ir bandymo darbus;
nustatyti medicinos įrangos gedimus, jų priežastis ir pagal kompetenciją atlikti smulkius remonto darbus;
vertinti medicinos įrangos techninę būklę, saugios eksploatacijos galimybes ir užtikrinti, kad įranga būtų naudojama pagal gamintojo reikalavimus;
organizuoti ir koordinuoti remonto, techninės priežiūros, patikrų ar kitus darbus, kai reikalingas išorinių paslaugų teikėjų, gamintojų ar jų įgaliotų atstovų dalyvavimas;
inicijuoti atsarginių dalių, eksploatacinių medžiagų, remonto, techninės priežiūros ir techninės būklės vertinimo poreikį.

title: Medic. įrangos priež. tarnybos specialistas
description:
medicininės įrangos priežiūros tarnybos specialistas (-ė) atliks ligoninėje naudojamos medicinos įrangos, gedimų nustatymo, smulkių remonto darbų atlikimas;
nustatyti medicinos įrangos gedimus, jų priežastis ir pagal kompetenciją šalinti gedimus;
atlikti smulkius medicinos įrangos remonto darbus;
vertinti medicinos įrangos techninę būklę ir saugios eksploatacijos galimybes;
atlikti medicinos įrangos veikimo patikrinimus po remonto ar techninės priežiūros darbų;
dalyvauti demontuojant naudotą medicinos įrangą ir paruošiant patalpas naujos įrangos montavimui;
fiksuoti informaciją apie atliktą techninę priežiūrą, remontą, gedimus, panaudotas detales ir atliktus darbus medicinos įrangos techniniuose pasuose, žurnaluose ar kitose apskaitos formose;
informuoti tiesioginį vadovą apie nustatytas problemas, gedimus ar rizikas.

title: Elektrikas (-ė) - automatikas (-ė)
description:
AB Liteksas kviečia į techninio aptarnavimo skyrių prisijungti elektriką-automatiką, kuris bus atsakingas už:
Audimo staklių ir kitų gamybos įrengimų elektrinės ir automatinės dalies techninę priežiūrą, užtikrinant patikimą įrenginių darbą;
Gedimų nustatymo, jų šalinimo, derinimo ir programavimo darbus;
Efektyvų planinių ir avarinių elektrinės dalies remonto darbų vykdymą;
Glaudų bendradarbiavimą su audimo cecho vyr. techniku planuojant staklių remonto darbus;
Prevencinių veiksmų siūlymą atlikus gedimų analizę ir nustačius priežastis;
Reikalingų atsarginių detalių sandėlio likučių sekimą ir užsakymą;

title: Įrengimų valdymo operatorius (-ė) - vadovas (-ė)
description:
automatizuotų elektros įrenginių valdymas ir paruošimas technologiniam procesui.
Gaminamos produkcijos kokybės, technologinio proceso standartų, saugaus darbo ir efektyvumo užtikrinimas. Reikiamos dokumentacijos pildymas ir dalyvavimas jos ruošime. Įrenginių priežiūra bei dalyvavimas jų remonto procese.

title: Kokybės kontrolierius (-ė)
description:
Įmonės gaminamos produkcijos kokybės tikrinimas gamybos proceso metu:
-trinkelių atrinkimas, trinkelių aukščio matavimas;
-gaminamos produkcijos kokybės kontrolė pagal nustatytas procedūras;
      *nekokybiškų gaminių pašalinimas nuo patekimo į tolimesnius gamybos procesus;
      *stebėjimas brokuotos produkcijos, ją pakeičiant nauja/kokybiška;
-intensyvus darbas prie technologinės gamybos linijos;
-remonto bei kiti pagalbiniai darbai.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Dans un environnement en constant/ante évolution, l'ACD joue un rôle fondamental dans l'accompagnement des contribuables, la promotion de la transparence fiscale, et l'optimisation de l'efficacité des processus administratifs. L'ACD est également un acteur clé de la transformation numérique de l'administration publique et de l'amélioration continue des services offerts aux citoyens. L'ACD engage un vaste programme de transformation digitale pour remplacer son système informatique central, actuellement basé sur des technologies COBOL/Mainframe, par une nouvelle architecture moderne, souveraine, modulaire et évolutive. title: Cost Management Team Leader (m/f)
description:
Cost Management Team Leader (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1125


Back to Search

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your next challenge:

• Lead the Bank's cost management framework, ensuring effective financial steering of operating expenses, investment spending, and strategic initiatives across all business units.
• Act as a trusted Finance partner to Senior Management and business leaders by providing insightful analysis, challenging spending decisions, identifying optimization opportunities, and ensuring alignment with the Bank's strategic objectives.
• Support Executive Management, the CFO and senior governance bodies in evaluating strategic projects, transformation initiatives, investments and acquisitions through robust financial analysis and business case assessments.
• Develop a strong cost-conscious culture across the organization while ensuring resources are allocated efficiently to support growth, regulatory requirements, operational resilience and strategic ambitions.
• Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for cost controlling, planning, analysis and management reporting.
• Own and continuously enhance the Bank's cost management framework, policies and governance.
• Lead the budget and forecasting processes for operating expenses and investment spending.
• Monitor cost performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying risks, opportunities and corrective actions.
• Lead the evolution of the Bank's cost allocation framework, ensuring transparent, accurate and business-relevant allocation of costs across customers, products, channels and business units to support profitability analysis, pricing decisions and strategic resource allocation.
• Act as primary Finance partner for senior executives, department heads and business leaders regarding cost management matters.
• Organize and lead periodic cost review meetings with ExCo members and senior management.
• Challenge business assumptions, investment requests and resource allocation decisions through a constructive and data-driven approach.
• Build strong relationships across Finance, COO, Risk, HR, CEO Office and Business Lines to ensure alignment on financial priorities.
• Support Management in evaluating strategic projects and transformation initiatives.
• Perform financial assessments of acquisitions, partnerships and strategic opportunities.
• Evaluate expected benefits, costs, risks and return on investment of major initiatives.
• Deliver timely, accurate and insightful management reporting on costs and investment performance.
• Conduct ad-hoc financial analyses and simulations on business initiatives, cost drivers and strategic options.
• Drive improvements in planning methodologies, management reporting and analytical capabilities.
• Promote automation and digitalization of cost management processes.
• Contribute to the evolution of Finance tools, data governance and performance management frameworks.
• Lead, coach and develop the Cost Management team.
• Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and high performance.
• Ensure appropriate succession planning, talent development and capability building within the team.

Your skills:

• Master's Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or related field. CFA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent qualifications considered an advantage.
• Minimum 12-15 years of experience in FP&A, Finance Business Partnering, Cost Management, Corporate Finance, Strategy or related fields within financial services.
• Minimum 5 years in leadership positions managing teams and engaging directly with executive management.
• Fluency in French and English. Luxembourgish and/or German considered an asset.
• Strong understanding of banking products, business models, profitability drivers, financial planning processes and performance management. Knowledge of banking regulatory environment and capital considerations is an advantage.
• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills. Strong knowledge of financial planning, reporting and data visualization tools. Experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) systems, Power BI, Microstrategy, or similar tools is a plus.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Ability to engage and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
• Strategic mindset combined with strong analytical capabilities.
• Excellent presentation skills and ability to translate complex financial information into actionable recommendations.
• Strong leadership and change management capabilities.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

title: EXPERIENCED RESEARCHER IN THE FIELD OF FRUGAL/GREEN AI (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The LIST AI Initiative, supported by the LIST Board of Directors, aims to expand LIST's AI capabilities and maximise the impact of AI innovation both within LIST (AI applied to scientific research in all LIST RDI units and AI applied to improve the performance of LIST corporate support functions) and outside LIST (AI applied to improve products, services and processes of private and public organisations through collaborative projects and/or contract research).
One of the key areas of interest in the LIST AI initiative is that of Frugal AI, understood in a very broad sense: from the analysis of “frugality” of current AI models to the selection/adaptation of models to be deployed in constrained resources (in terms of energy, memory…) depending on the client requirements as part of the design process of a new software system with sustainability concerns.

In this context, LIST is seeking to recruit an AI experienced researcher with a strong specialization and interest in the field of Frugal AI (and similar terms: green AI, low-resource AI, constrained AI, …).

You will join the LIST AI Initiative team as a member of the SWRDI research group and collaborate with peers in a dynamic and evolving research environment within the SWRDI group, the HANDS unit and, in general, with other LIST units requiring expertise in the Frugal AI field.

The SWRDI team specializes in the design and development of smart (i.e. AI-enhanced) software systems. We believe energy concerns should be part of the software design from its early stages and therefore, we believe there is the need to specify resource requirements as part of the requirements engineering phase. These requirements will be then analysed against the energy/memory requirements of AI models to optimize the system behaviour while minimizing the resources consumed by the AI components in it.

We'll expect from you to lead research and innovation (RDI) activities in Frugal AI. As an experienced researcher, you will take the lead in:
• Delivering Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) activities.
• Developing and coaching the LIST RDI teams in this topic; and
• Maximising the impact of Frugal AI initiatives through externally funded projects with public or private organisations.
Your role will include:
• Lead the research, development and innovation (RDI) activities on the Frugal AI topic, defining and shaping research directions in line with LIST's strategic objectives.
• Drive the development of innovative Frugal AI technologies and methodologies.
• Develop and manage RDI project proposals, ensuring alignment with strategic research objectives at the group and unit level. Identify funding and grant opportunities; prepare and submit proposals to secure financial support for RDI activities.
• Oversee the execution of RDI projects with external partners, ensuring that they meet their objectives, timelines and budgets.
•  Align with ongoing standards around Frugal AI and Green AI and explore opportunities and collaborations with the consortia behind those standards.
• Establish and maintain collaborations with industrial partners, public organisations, research institutes and universities to enhance research impact and technology transfer.
• Actively participate in EU and (inter)national consortia and contribute to collaborative research projects.
• Increase LIST's visibility in the AI field through publications, presentations and participation in relevant forums and conferences.

Deep scientific and technical expertise, demonstrated by publications and successful RDI projects, in at least some of these topics is required:
• Frugal AI / Green AI and, in general, the design and deployment of AI models in low-resource environments.
• Generative AI, including large language models (LLMs), multimodal foundation models, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning and optimisation techniques for LLMs.
• Use of AI to improve sustainability aspects of AI and non-AI systems based on an analysis of their current architecture and operational data.
• Machine learning and neural network architectures, including convolutional, recurrent and transformer networks.
• MLOps and model management to streamline ML development.
• Multimodal input and how multimodality impacts frugality.
• Data management, data valorisation and data processing techniques, including data sandboxes, data spaces, data synthesis and data augmentation.
• AI evaluation, assessment, testing and benchmarking, including AI sandbox.
• Knowledge of the latest trends and developments in AI, with the ability to apply these advances to practical, real-world challenges.
• Experience working with business domain experts to apply the above AI innovation capabilities in at least one vertical domain in the private and/or public sector, such as finance, space, cybersecurity, energy, mobility and logistics, defence, manufacturing, education, health, central or local government, etc.
• Sustainable practices and global initiatives in the area (UNESCO sustainable development goals, digital product passport initiatives, product circularity data sheets…) that may have influence in the evolution and growing interest in Frugal AI.
• Software engineering and, in particular, low-code technologies. This includes some knowledge of low-code and no-code AI approaches.

In addition, we would appreciate proven experience in the following soft skills:
• Passion for AI research and technology with a relentless drive for innovation.
• Proven experience in leading and managing RDI projects in AI/ML with a track record of successful project delivery and innovation.
• Experience of building and maintaining collaborative networks with academic, industrial and research partners, with excellent networking skills.
• Proven ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international environment, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-expert audiences.
• Experience in organising workshops, seminars and conferences to disseminate research findings and promote community engagement.
• Ability to identify emerging research areas and technology trends and set the direction for future research efforts and technological advances.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education
• PhD + at least 2 years of experience in advanced AI RDI activities.
Language skills
• Fluent English is a requirement. French, German or Luxembourgish is an advantage.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
•  Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 50 nationalities represented in our workforce

About the Role

This is a pivotal leadership role responsible for designing, building and leading Uplift360's operational backbone.
As Operations Director, you will oversee the company's operational infrastructure, business services, corporate operations, governance and support functions across Luxembourg and the United Kingdom, ensuring the organisation operates efficiently, compliantly and at scale.
Working directly with the Co-Founders, CTO and Senior Leadership Team, you will establish the operational systems, governance frameworks and management disciplines required to support accelerated growth, investor readiness, customer delivery and industrial expansion.
A key objective of the role is to help Uplift360 scale intelligently through the adoption of automation, AI-enabled workflows and modern digital operating systems. You will be expected to identify opportunities to increase organisational productivity, strengthen decision-making and reduce operational overhead through the effective application of technology.
Success in the role will be measured not only by organisational growth, but by your ability to build a scalable operating model that combines exceptional people, robust processes and intelligent technology - enabling growth without a proportional increase in administrative complexity or headcount.
The role has management responsibility for the HR function and broader business services team. However, this is not an HR leadership position. The Operations Director will ensure that the HR function is appropriately resourced, managed and aligned to business priorities, but will not personally deliver HR services or own the company's people strategy.
Responsibility for HR strategy, workforce planning, organisational design, reward strategy and board-level people governance remains with the founders and designated HR leadership.
This role combines strategic leadership with operational execution and is ideally suited to an experienced operational leader who has successfully scaled organisations in high-growth, venture-backed or industrial environments.

About Uplift360

Uplift360 is an Advanced Materials Company securing sovereign supply for Europe's defence, security and vital industries.
We secure and produce critical advanced materials, including carbon fibre and aramids, for European defence and industry by sourcing, recovering and regenerating high-value materials into secure industrial supply chains.
As geopolitical instability, supply chain fragility and industrial competition intensify, access to advanced materials is becoming a defining strategic advantage. Uplift360 is building the infrastructure and technology required to secure it.

As a Director of Operations, your key accountabilities will include:

Business Operations and Operational Excellence:  Lead the development and continuous improvement of Uplift360's operating model, ensuring efficiency, accountability and scalability across Luxembourg and UK operations.

• Provide leadership across corporate infrastructure, governance, risk management and business support functions.
• Establish and maintain operational governance, reporting and performance frameworks.
• Develop scalable processes, controls and workflows across the business.
• Lead operational planning and resource coordination across Luxembourg and UK operations.

• Develop KPIs, dashboards and management reporting.
• Facilitate leadership operating rhythms, action tracking and accountability.
• Ensure operational processes scale effectively as the company grows.

Digital Transformation and AI-Enabled Scaling

• Lead the development of a modern, technology-enabled operating model capable of supporting rapid growth, stronger decision-making and industrial scaling without adding unnecessary administrative burden.
• Develop and implement a roadmap for operational scalability through automation, AI and process optimisation.
• Identify and automate repetitive administrative, reporting and coordination activities.
• Deploy practical digital tools for workflow management, document control, action tracking, meeting cadence and cross-functional collaboration.
• Champion data-driven decision-making through dashboards, management reporting and operational analytics.
• Partner with functional leaders to simplify workflows, reduce hand-offs and remove avoidable inefficiencies.
• Ensure AI and technology solutions are deployed responsibly, securely and in line with company governance requirements.

Strategic Projects and Company Execution

• Act as a key operational partner to the founders in delivering strategic, cross-functional and growth-critical initiatives.
• Lead company-wide projects that improve organisational capability and effectiveness.
• Coordinate strategic planning activities, leadership initiatives and cross-functional execution priorities.
• Support customer, investor, partner and government stakeholder engagement where operational coordination is required.
• Ensure operational readiness for audits, funding reviews, due diligence exercises and growth milestones.
• Drive execution of business priorities through structured programme management, action tracking and escalation discipline.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Personal Qualities:

• 10+ years' experience in Operations Leadership, Business Operations, General Management, Chief of Staff or related leadership roles.
• Experience within high-growth, venture-backed, technology, manufacturing, industrial or deep-tech environments.
• Proven track record of building scalable operational frameworks and business systems.
• Experience leading cross-functional business services and operational support functions.
• Practical experience implementing automation, AI-enabled workflows, digital collaboration tools, dashboards or process improvements that materially improve organisational productivity.
• Strong understanding of governance, risk management and operational compliance.
• Demonstrated success partnering with founders and executive teams.
