title: Automotive After Sales Manager
description:
Automotive After Sales Manager  
We are seeking a technically experienced After\-Sales Manager to lead our after\-sales operations and support our dealer and workshop network across Switzerland.  
This role requires strong leadership and communication skills, solid technical automotive expertise, and sound commercial acumen. The ideal candidate can effectively balance customer expectations, dealer needs, and business objectives while promoting sustainable growth throughout the network.  
Please apply only if you have professional experience in the automotive industry in after sales.  
Your Responsibilities  
Dealer Network Management, build strong relationships, provide support, monitor performance (KPIs, Service Standards), and implement strategies to improve overall performance and profitability.  
Customer Experience, Own the customer journey, resolve complex complaints and warranty issues, and promote high service levels across the region.  
Performance and Strategy, achieve regional financial and non\-financial targets, implement Aftersales Plans, and identify opportunities for growth.  
Technical and Training, Support Technicians, manage high value warranty claims, conduct training, ensure correct tooling, and identify broader product issues.  
Operations and Logistics, ensure parts availability, report any dealer parts supply and or logistics issues, manage service campaigns and recalls and oversee regional workshops and stake holders.  
Brand Representation, Act as a brand ambassador, ensure consistent standards and representation of the brand within the network, and at internal and external events and in all communications.  
What You Bring  
Mandatory requirement: Demonstrable automotive after\-sales experience, with in\-depth knowledge of Service and Parts operations, Warranty processes, Technical Support, dealer and workshop Training, and Parts Logistics. Candidates with sales\-only experience will not be considered.  
Strong leadership, people management, and relationship building skills.  
Collaborate across all functions, within Aftersales, Sales and all operational areas of the business.  
Strong knowledge of vehicle diagnostics, repair processes, warranty, technical training and parts operations  
Experience supporting technicians, workshops and dealer networks with complex technical cases  
The ability to work with internal departments including Diagnostics and Technical Publications, Parts, Warranty, technical Support and Customer Service.  
Have an excellent level of communication skills (written and verbal in German and English) and the ability to always present and make yourself understood by your audience.  
Be self\-motivated, confident and professional – This role, is always representing the MG brand and often the face of the brand from an Aftersales perspective.  
What We Offer  
Join a fast\-growing international automotive brand.  
Dynamic, collaborative environment.  
Modern co\-working space in Zurich Nord.  
Competitive compensation and insurance benefits.  
The chance to help grow our company Switzerland.  
A supportive team environment where new ideas are welcome.  
How Success is measured  
Customer satisfaction and effective resolution of complex complaints.  
Dealer and workshop performance against agreed after\-sales KPIs.  
Growth in after\-sales revenue and profitability.  
Consistent implementation of brand standards and after\-sales strategies.  
Dealer participation in required technical and commercial training.  
Strong dealer relationships and high stakeholder satisfaction.  
Timely, accurate reporting and completion of agreed action plans.  
Ready to Join the Journey?  
If you're excited about joining an innovative automotive brand and want to contribute to our continued success in Switzerland, we'd love to hear from you. Please send us your CV in English.  
Please note: We do not work with recruitment agencies. Kindly refrain from contacting us regarding recruitment services.  
Marín \- HR Manager \- MG Motor Switzerland jpida6d44bejm jit0730jm jiy26jm

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
New Work bénéficie d'un bel héritage et traverse des périodes extraordinai  
Digital Marketing Specialist (H/F)  
New Work bénéficie d'un bel héritage et traverse des périodes extraordinaires grâce à l'implication et à la passion de ses collaborateurs depuis plus de 25 ans.  
Afin de bâtir l'avenir, nous souhaitons étoffer nos équipes, repositionner notre marque et innover. Nous croyons fermement qu'une marque forte se vit autant qu'elle se raconte. Raison pour laquelle nous souhaitons nous entourer d'un Digital Marketing Specialist (H/F) pour renforcer notre présence en ligne. Vous serez basé au siège du groupe situé à Granges\-Paccot et intégrerez une équipe soudée, dynamique et passionnée, dans laquelle votre créativité et vos idées seront pleinement valorisées.  
Vos futures responsabilités  
Vous contribuerez à définir et déployer une stratégie digitale nationale alignée avec les valeurs et ambitions de l'entreprise.  
Vous serez en charge de la visibilité en ligne et de la e\-réputation de l'entreprise en assurant une présence digitale cohérente et impactante.  
Vous créerez du contenu percutant (vidéos, infographies, illustrations, …) adapté aux différents types de supports.  
Vous gérerez les réseaux sociaux en planifiant, publiant et en interagissant avec la communauté.  
Vous participerez à l'évolution continue du site web afin d'optimiser l'expérience utilisateur et la performance digitale.  
Vous analyserez les performances digitales via des outils de tracking et serez force de proposition pour maximiser l'impact des actions menées.  
Vous assurerez une veille digitale afin d'identifier les tendances émergentes et les meilleures pratiques.  
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes pour garantir une cohérence entre la stratégie digitale et la communication globale de l'entreprise.  
Votre profil  
Vous êtes au bénéfice d'une formation en création de contenu, communication digitale ou marketing digital.  
Vous êtes de langue maternelle française ou allemande, avec un niveau minimum C1 dans l'autre langue. Une autre langue est un atout.  
Vous maîtrisez les outils nécessaires à la mise en pratique de vos tâches, tels que Adobe Creative Suite, Google Analytics, Wordpress, …  
Vous êtes passionné par les nouvelles technologies et maîtrisez les dernières tendances du digital.  
Vous avez une excellente capacité à raconter des histoires et à créer des contenus engageants.  
Vous êtes une personne curieuse, créative, dynamique et adorez relever de nouveaux défis.  
Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un univers agile, alliant exigence et performance.  
Vous avez un réel savoir\-être (disponibilité, rigueur, relationnel, charisme…).  
Vous possédez le sens de l'initiative et savez gérer urgences et priorités.  
Nos conditions  
Notre politique interne est basée sur l'écoute, le partage et une véritable responsabilisation de tous nos collaborateurs. Nous vous offrons un cadre de travail en pleine mutation, inspiré des dernières tendances RH, ainsi qu'une culture d'entreprise qui favorise l'innovation et le développement personnel. Nous prenons soin de nos talents et travaillons ensemble pour un projet commun.  
Rejoignez une équipe de passionnés et soyez prêt à relever les défis avec engagement et plaisir ! Si vous recherchez un challenge professionnel et pensez correspondre au profil recherché, n'hésitez pas à postuler ! Nous apprécions les postulations avec dossier complet (CV, diplômes, certificats) accompagné d'un portfolio présentant vos réalisations et projets les plus marquants. jpidd1b5363jm jpit0730jm jpiy26jm

title: Junior TV Consultant
description:
Junior TV Consultant (m/w/d)  
About WPP Media  
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.  
WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.  
For more information, visit .  
Das bieten wir dir:  
Work\-Life\-Balance: Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten \& Remote Work gestaltest du deinen Alltag so, wie er zu dir passt. Außerdem kannst du Überstunden ausgleichen.  
Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24\. und 31\.12\. .  
Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.  
Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP\-Netzwerk.  
More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.  
Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen \- Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.  
Das bewegst du:  
Als Junior TV Consultant (m/w/d) steigst du tief in die Welt der TV\-Planung und Kampagnensteuerung ein. Du unterstützt unser Team bei der strategischen Beratung namhafter Kunden, behältst Leistungswerte im Blick und lernst Schritt für Schritt, wie man erfolgreiche Bewegtbild\-Kampagnen von der Planung bis zur Analyse operativ begleitet.  
Kampagnenplanung \& Support: Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von TV\-Jahresplanungen und taktischen Kampagnen\-Empfehlungen durch Datenbeschaffung sowie die zielgerichtete Aufbereitung von Charts.  
Schnittstellenmanagement zum Einkauf: Enge Abstimmung mit dem TV\-Buying\-Team bei der Einsteuerung von Buchungen und der Umsetzung von Optimierungswünschen unter Anleitung.  
Datenanalyse \& Insights: Erste eigenständige Analyse von relevanten Leistungswerten (z. B. GRPs, Netto\-Reichweiten, Kontakte, TKPs) und Ableitung erster grundlegender Erkenntnisse für unsere Kunden.  
Kampagnenkontrolle \& \-optimierung: Laufende operative Überwachung aktiver TV\-Kampagnen (Soll/Ist\-Vergleiche, Platzierungsprüfungen) zur Sicherung und Einhaltung aller definierten Kunden\-KPIs.  
Kunden\- \& Beratungs\-Support: Beantwortung grundlegender, operativer Kundenanfragen (z. B. zu Sendezeiten, Materialfristen oder Verschiebungen) sowie Unterstützung der Client\-Service\-Teams bei TV\-spezifischen Themen.  
Zusammenarbeit \& Weiterbildung: Proaktive Zusammenarbeit mit internen Projekt\- und Offshore\-Teams sowie Teilnahme an branchenrelevanten Events (z. B. Screenforce, Screen\-up oder AGF\-Austausch) zur eigenen Weiterentwicklung.  
Das zeichnet dich aus:  
Spaß an Zahlen \& Analytik: Ein gutes mathematisches Grundverständnis sowie die Bereitschaft, analytisch zu denken, um dich Schritt für Schritt in die Welt der Kampagnendaten einzuarbeiten.  
Erste MS\-Office\-Kenntnisse: Erste solide Erfahrungen im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere die Motivation, deine Kenntnisse in Excel (für Daten) und PowerPoint (für Präsentationen) bei uns zu vertiefen.  
Sorgfalt \& Detailorientierung: Eine strukturierte, zuverlässige und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise, damit du auch bei der Kontrolle von Sendezeiten stets den Überblick behältst.  
Kommunikation \& Teamgeist: Freude an offener Kommunikation, eine freundliche Art und echtes Interesse daran, im Team gemeinsam zu lernen und sich gegenseitig zu unterstützen.  
Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, um dich sowohl in unserem lokalen Team als auch im internationalen Umfeld sicher zu bewegen.  
Begeisterung für Bewegtbild (kein Muss): Erstes Interesse an der modernen Fernseh\- und Videolandschaft sowie Lust darauf, zu lernen, wie man mit Daten spannende Geschichten erzählt.  
Darüber hinaus bist du: \#ready\-to\-learn \#ready\-to\-grow \#video\-enthusiast  
Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.  
Arbeiten bei WPP Media:  
Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events \- zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.  
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.  
Bitte lies unsere Datenschutzerklärung für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz, um weitere Informationen darüber zu erhalten, wie wir die von dir bereitgestellten Daten verarbeiten. \#LI\-Promoted 11703 jpidd0d748bjm jit0730jm jiy26jm

title: Digital Marketing and Event Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing and Event Specialist  
We are a fast\-growing technology scale\-up, seeking highly motivated and talented individuals who are eager to shape the future with us. As our Digital Marketing and Events Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening MaxWell Biosystems' global brand and customer engagement. Based at our headquarters in Zurich, you will develop and execute digital marketing initiatives, and coordinate impactful digital and in\-person events that connect our international community of researchers.  
This position is ideal for a creative, proactive, and highly organized marketing professional with experience in digital marketing, marketing automation (HubSpot), email marketing (Mailchimp), content creation, and event management. You enjoy combining strategic thinking with hands\-on execution, thrive in a collaborative and fast\-paced environment, and are motivated by bringing innovative technologies to the global scientific community.  
Your Responsibilities  
Execute MaxWell Biosystems' digital marketing strategy across multiple channels, ensuring alignment with the company's brand and commercial objectives.  
Plan, implement, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns, including email marketing, social media, digital advertising, and content marketing.  
Create and manage marketing automation activities and newsletter in Mailchimp/HubSpot, lead nurturing, campaign execution, and performance tracking.  
Support the creation and promotion of compelling marketing content, including videos, graphics, flyers, customer success stories, testimonials, and other digital assets.  
Collaborate with external agencies, designers, photographers, videographers, and other creative partners to deliver high\-quality multimedia content.  
Plan, coordinate, and promote digital and in\-person marketing events organized by MaxWell Biosystems, including webinars, user meetings, workshops, and customer engagement activities.  
Develop event communication plans and marketing materials to maximize attendance, engagement, and post\-event follow\-up.  
Partner closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and Commercial Excellence teams to develop and execute integrated marketing initiatives.  
Monitor and analyse campaign and event performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.  
Identify opportunities to improve marketing processes, workflows, and the effective use of digital marketing tools.  
Act as an internal resource for digital marketing best practices, providing guidance and training to colleagues on marketing platforms and tools.  
Your Profile  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field. Alternatively, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biotechnology, Neuroscience, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline with formal coursework, training, or equivalent experience in Marketing and Communications.  
3\+ years of experience in B2B digital marketing, including the planning and promotion of scientific events (webinars, conferences, workshops, or customer engagement activities). Experience in the life sciences, biotechnology, healthcare, or technology sectors is preferred.  
Proven experience planning and executing multi\-channel marketing campaigns and coordinating digital and in\-person events, including webinars, conferences, and customer engagement activities.  
Hands\-on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred), email marketing tools (e.g., Mailchimp), and social media management.  
Experience creating engaging marketing content across multiple formats, including email campaigns, presentations, videos, graphics, and digital assets. Proficiency with Canva and/or Adobe Creative Suite is an advantage.  
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.  
Experience in analysing campaign performance and using marketing metrics to optimize results.  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.  
A proactive, creative, and collaborative mindset, with strong interpersonal skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams and with external partners.  
A strong interest in neuroscience, life sciences, or scientific technologies.  
What we offer you  
Centrally located workplace, flexible working hours model incl. home office as well as training and further education opportunities.  
Are you motivated, and committed to delivering first\-rate performance? Do you enjoy working in an international, multidisciplinary, and interactive team?  
Then, our Head of Commercial Excellence and Engagement, Dr. D’Ignazio, looks forward to receiving your application documents (cover letter, resume, letter of recommendation and sample works). jpidcbd2253jm jit0730jm jiy26jm

title: Head of Medical Scientific Affairs
description:
Head of Medical Scientific Affairs (ID2121\)  
The AO is a medically guided, not\-for\-profit organization, a global network of surgeons, and the world's leading education, innovation, and research organization specializing in the surgical treatment of trauma and musculoskeletal disorders. We are home to people from all over the world, from different backgrounds, with diverse talents and specialist areas. What binds us together is our passion for excellence, our dedication to our mission of improving patient care, and our understanding that we are stronger together: we are one AO.  
For more information, visit: /  
Head of Medical Scientific Affairs (ID2121\)  
Short Description  
The Head of Medical Scientific Affairs provides strategic and scientific leadership for AO's clinical evidence generation ecosystem and ensures that clinical research investments translate into meaningful improvements in patient care.  
He/she serves as a trusted scientific advisor to AO leadership, governance committees, and clinical divisions and represents AO ITC in internal and external scientific initiatives, partnerships, and expert forums.  
The role is accountable for developing a high\-impact portfolio of clinical studies across Trauma, CMF, Spine,TC, Veterinary, and related orthopedic disciplines, ensuring optimal allocation of resources, scientific excellence, and supporting effective translation of evidence into clinical practice.  
The position serves as a key interface between surgeons, researchers, clinical operations, governance bodies, industry partners, and educational stakeholders to maximize the generation, dissemination, and adoption of evidence\-based innovations within the AO ecosystem.  
Main Responsibilities  
Lead the Medical Scientific Affairs team  
Provide scientific, strategic and operational leadership to the Medical Scientific Affairs team with two direct reports, fostering a high\-performing, collaborative, and service\-oriented culture.  
Define team objectives, priorities, and performance expectations aligned with the organization's strategy and portfolio needs.  
Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate team members to support professional growth, ensuring the appropriate scientific, clinical, and operational competencies are in place.  
Close collaboration with Clinical Operations in the resource planning and allocation across studies, programs, and stakeholder requests to meet organizational objectives.  
Build effective collaboration between surgeons, governance bodies, Clinical Operations, NCR, AO Education Institute, AO Research Institute, educators, and external partners to advance the Clinical Research activities in the AO.  
Drive continuous improvement of Medical Scientific Affairs processes, standards, and capabilities to enhance quality, efficiency, and impact and establish a culture of scientific excellence, integrity, compliance, and evidence\-based decision\-making across all Medical Scientific Affairs activities.  
Lead the Clinical Science Advisory Commission (CSAC).  
Lead the AO ITC Clinical Research Fellowship Program.  
Support the AO PEER program.  
Clinical Study Design \& Scientific Support  
Develop clinical study protocols addressing important knowledge gaps and clinical needs in close collaboration with surgeons, industry partners, governance bodies and Network Clinical Research and Clinical Operations.  
Review and provide medical\-scientific assessment of adverse events and safety\-related findings throughout study conduct.  
Provide expert advice on medical and scientific questions arising during study execution and support preparation of scientific publications, clinical reports, congress abstracts, and other dissemination activities.  
Close collaborate with Clinical Operations in study planning, implementation, and monitoring activities.  
Support interpretation of results in close collaboration with surgeons, investigators, governance bodies, and Clinical Operations.  
Drive excellence in scientific publication strategies, congress presentations, and dissemination activities.  
Clinical Research Portfolio Strategy  
Lead scientific discussions regarding future evidence needs.  
Develop and maintain a strategic clinical research portfolio in collaboration with the Research Commissions and internal stakeholders which is aligned with AO's mission and priorities.  
Establish and continuously refine portfolio prioritization frameworks balancing available research funding, knowledge gaps, patient impact, scientific significance, feasibility, cost\-effectiveness and translational potential and risk\-benefit considerations in collaboration with the Research Commissions and internal stakeholders.  
Monitor portfolio performance with regards to strategic objectives and adapt research priorities based on emerging evidence, and clinical needs.  
Provide scientific leadership across the full research lifecycle, ensuring methodological rigor, clinical relevance, regulatory compliance, and ethical conduct.  
Collaborate with Clinical Operations in establishing a grant acquisition strategy and strengthen industry partnerships and drive grant acquisition.  
Support Knowledge Translation activities to ensure clinical evidence generated by AO is effectively translated into education, clinical guidelines, decision support tools, and clinical practice.  
Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations, NCR, AO Education, AO Clinical Divisions, community development and governance bodies to facilitate adoption of new evidence.  
Lead implementation of health economic and outcomes research initiatives.  
Main Requirements  
Professional \& Technical Skills  
Advanced expertise in clinical research methodology.  
Strong understanding of orthopedic clinical practice and research.  
Advanced expertise in clinical study design, statistical principles, and evidence synthesis.  
Experience in designing and executing industry sponsored clinical studies as a CRO.  
Experience in health economic evaluation and outcomes research.  
Excellent scientific grant and publication writing and presentation skills.  
Sound understanding of regulatory requirements, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and clinical research governance.  
Education \& Qualifications  
Medical Degree (MD) required.  
PhD, MSc, or equivalent advanced scientific qualification highly desirable.  
Formal training in clinical epidemiology, research methodology, biostatistics, or related disciplines is advantageous.  
Professional Experience  
Minimum 10 years of experience in clinical research within orthopedics, trauma, spine, CMF, sports medicine, or related disciplines.  
Experience in multicenter clinical studies from concept generation to publication and dissemination.  
Experience in developing and managing research portfolios and clinical research strategies.  
Strong track record of peer\-reviewed scientific publications and grant acquisition.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Shape and lead the integrated evidence strategy across the Rare Disease portfolio and brands, ensuring evidence plans are aligned with therapy area strategies and business priorities.

Drive design and execution of priority real world evidence (RWE) and Investigator Sponsored Study (ISS) activities, providing expert input on study concepts, coordinating delivery across teams and markets, and ensuring evidence generation supports launch and lifecycle goals.

Lead and coordinate the evidence team, including Evidence Generation Associate Directors and Project Managers, ensuring clear priorities, strong execution, progress tracking and delivery against timelines, budgets and impact.

Translate evidence into impact, working with Publications, Scientific Communication and cross-functional teams to ensure study outputs are communicated effectively and embedded into key scientific dialogue deliverables.

Build evidence generation capability, acting as a subject matter expert and mentor for the evidence team and wider Medical Affairs organisation.

Partner across the enterprise, building strong collaboration with Medical Affairs, Commercial, Market Access, R&D, affiliates, RWE/Data Science experts and external stakeholders to address portfolio evidence needs.

Contribute to Medical Affairs functional leadership team, helping set direction, prioritise resources, develop talent and strengthen a state-of-the-art Medical Affairs organisation focused on advancing patient care.



Your new department  

You will join Global Medical Affairs Rare Disease, a global organisation dedicated to improving outcomes for people living with rare diseases. The team works across therapy areas and functional disciplines to generate insights, shape medical strategy, drive scientific dialogue, support clinical care pathways, and build organisational readiness for current and future assets.

The Evidence Generation function plays a central role in ensuring that our strategies are supported by high-quality evidence and that evidence activities are focused on the questions that matter most for patients, healthcare professionals, payers, regulators and healthcare systems. You will work with highly skilled colleagues across the global Rare Disease organisation and with regional and affiliate teams in key markets.



Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for a strategic, collaborative and scientifically strong leader who can operate with confidence in a global, matrixed organisation. You combine evidence generation expertise with a clear understanding of Medical Affairs impact, external stakeholder needs, cross-functional team needs and the realities of launch and lifecycle management.

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:

Over 10 years of evidence generation experience within the pharmaceutical or pharmaceutical service industry, including global, regional, or multi-country exposure, ideally in rare disease or specialty care.  

Proven track record in influential leadership and ability to build and drive high-performing evidence activities and complex strategic projects

Strong understanding of pharmaceutical governance, compliance, quality and ethical requirements related to evidence generation and external collaborations.

Proven ability to build teams and lead cross-functional teams without direct authority, influence senior stakeholders and translate complex evidence topics into clear strategic recommendations.

Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to create alignment, present to senior audiences and engage credibly with scientific experts.

A structured, impact-oriented approach to prioritisation, resource allocation and execution in a complex global environment.



Working at Novo Nordisk

At Novo Nordisk, we do not wait for change. We drive it. We are a dynamic company in an even more dynamic industry, and we know that what got us to where we are today is not necessarily what will make us successful in the future. We embrace experimentation, strive for excellence without fixating on perfection, and never shy away from opportunities to develop. From research and development to manufacturing, marketing, medical affairs and sales, we are all working to move the needle on patient care.





Deadline

Please apply by Aug 31st. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.



Equality of opportunity

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants. At Novo Nordisk we recognise that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to aspire to be the best company for the world, and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and the communities we operate in.



Together, we are changing life

Join us in shaping evidence that can help transform the future of care for people living with rare diseases.

title: Head of Medical Scientific Affairs (ID2121)
description:
The AO is a medically guided, not-for-profit organization, a global network of surgeons, and the world's leading education, innovation, and research organization specializing in the surgical treatment of trauma and musculoskeletal disorders. We are home to people from all over the world, from different backgrounds, with diverse talents and specialist areas. What binds us together is our passion for excellence, our dedication to our mission of improving patient care, and our understanding that we are stronger together: we are one AO.
For more information, visit: https://www.aofoundation.org/

The AO Innovation Translation Center (AO ITC) streamlines and drives innovation projects. Its activities include the development of clinical solutions with our industrial partner, innovation gathering, proof-of-concept studies, strategic investment in intellectual property, technology, or companies, and evidence creation through clinical research.

As part of the AO ITC, Clinical Operations is the AO’s service provider for clinical research. Our clinical research specialists deliver clinical insights that are highly relevant to current surgical practice and enable better patient care by planning and conducting global clinical trials.



The Head of Medical Scientific Affairs provides strategic and scientific leadership for AO's clinical evidence generation ecosystem and ensures that clinical research investments translate into meaningful improvements in patient care.

He/she serves as a trusted scientific advisor to AO leadership, governance committees, and clinical divisions and represents AO ITC in internal and external scientific initiatives, partnerships, and expert forums.
The role is accountable for developing a high-impact portfolio of clinical studies across Trauma, CMF, Spine,TC, Veterinary, and related orthopedic disciplines, ensuring optimal allocation of resources, scientific excellence, and supporting effective translation of evidence into clinical practice.
The position serves as a key interface between surgeons, researchers, clinical operations, governance bodies, industry partners, and educational stakeholders to maximize the generation, dissemination, and adoption of evidence-based innovations within the AO ecosystem.



Main Responsibilities:

Lead the Medical Scientific Affairs team

Provide scientific, strategic and operational leadership to the Medical Scientific Affairs team with two direct reports, fostering a high-performing, collaborative, and service-oriented culture.
Define team objectives, priorities, and performance expectations aligned with the organization's strategy and portfolio needs.
Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate team members to support professional growth, ensuring the appropriate scientific, clinical, and operational competencies are in place.
Close collaboration with Clinical Operations in the resource planning and allocation across studies, programs, and stakeholder requests to meet organizational objectives.
Build effective collaboration between surgeons, governance bodies, Clinical Operations, NCR, AO Education Institute, AO Research Institute, educators, and external partners to advance the Clinical Research activities in the AO.
Drive continuous improvement of Medical Scientific Affairs processes, standards, and capabilities to enhance quality, efficiency, and impact and establish a culture of scientific excellence, integrity, compliance, and evidence-based decision-making across all Medical Scientific Affairs activities.
Lead the Clinical Science Advisory Commission (CSAC).
Lead the AO ITC Clinical Research Fellowship Program.
Support the AO PEER program.


Clinical Study Design & Scientific Support

Develop clinical study protocols addressing important knowledge gaps and clinical needs in close collaboration with surgeons, industry partners, governance bodies and Network Clinical Research and Clinical Operations.
Review and provide medical-scientific assessment of adverse events and safety-related findings throughout study conduct.
Provide expert advice on medical and scientific questions arising during study execution and support preparation of scientific publications, clinical reports, congress abstracts, and other dissemination activities.
Close collaborate with Clinical Operations in study planning, implementation, and monitoring activities.
Support interpretation of results in close collaboration with surgeons, investigators, governance bodies, and Clinical Operations.
Drive excellence in scientific publication strategies, congress presentations, and dissemination activities.


Clinical Research Portfolio Strategy

Lead scientific discussions regarding future evidence needs.
Develop and maintain a strategic clinical research portfolio in collaboration with the Research Commissions and internal stakeholders which is aligned with AO's mission and priorities.
Establish and continuously refine portfolio prioritization frameworks balancing available research funding, knowledge gaps, patient impact, scientific significance, feasibility, cost-effectiveness and translational potential and risk-benefit considerations in collaboration with the Research Commissions and internal stakeholders.
Monitor portfolio performance with regards to strategic objectives and adapt research priorities based on emerging evidence, and clinical needs.
Provide scientific leadership across the full research lifecycle, ensuring methodological rigor, clinical relevance, regulatory compliance, and ethical conduct.
Collaborate with Clinical Operations in establishing a grant acquisition strategy and strengthen industry partnerships and drive grant acquisition.
Support Knowledge Translation activities to ensure clinical evidence generated by AO is effectively translated into education, clinical guidelines, decision support tools, and clinical practice.
Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations, NCR, AO Education, AO Clinical Divisions, community development and governance bodies to facilitate adoption of new evidence.
Lead implementation of health economic and outcomes research initiatives.


Main Requirements:

Professional & Technical Skills

Advanced expertise in clinical research methodology.
Strong understanding of orthopedic clinical practice and research.
Advanced expertise in clinical study design, statistical principles, and evidence synthesis.
Experience in designing and executing industry sponsored clinical studies as a CRO.
Experience in health economic evaluation and outcomes research.
Excellent scientific grant and publication writing and presentation skills.
Sound understanding of regulatory requirements, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and clinical research governance.


Education & Qualifications

Medical Degree (MD) required.
PhD, MSc, or equivalent advanced scientific qualification highly desirable.
Formal training in clinical epidemiology, research methodology, biostatistics, or related disciplines is advantageous.


Professional Experience

Minimum 10 years of experience in clinical research within orthopedics, trauma, spine, CMF, sports medicine, or related disciplines.
Experience in multicenter clinical studies from concept generation to publication and dissemination.
Experience in developing and managing research portfolios and clinical research strategies.
Strong track record of peer-reviewed scientific publications and grant acquisition.
Experience in line management and leading interdisciplinary and cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with surgeons and international clinical research networks.
CRO services are of advantage.


We offer:

An interesting and varied job in an exciting and innovative organization
The opportunity to be part of a highly committed international team
Modern infrastructure
High degree of flexibility regarding working hours and location (depending on operational requirements)
Generous package of social benefits, including supplementary vacation days and pension scheme contributions
Internal skills training opportunities and support for continued education

title: Application Engineer - Technology Preparation
description:
Application Engineer \- Technology Preparation  
Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man\-made fibers into short\-staple and long\-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man\-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. Rieter has a history spanning more than 230 years, operates 17 production sites in nine countries, and employs around 4 220 people worldwide, approximately 15\.4% of them in Switzerland. Rieter is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol RIEN.  
As an Application Engineer – Technology Preparation, you will be part of the Technology Preparation Team and support the research, development, validation, and continuous improvement of next\-generation preparation machines. You will contribute to technology development activities, machine testing, customer support, and lifetime testing while working closely with cross\-functional teams and customers worldwide.  
The role combines hands\-on machine expertise, textile process know\-how, analytical problem\-solving, and customer interaction to ensure innovative and reliable solutions throughout the machine development lifecycle.  
Application Engineer – Technology Preparation  
Your Tasks  
Support the identification and evaluation of technological opportunities for next\-generation preparation machines.  
Contribute to research and development activities, including technological trials from carded sliver to yarn.  
Perform machine conversions, modifications, and adjustments on research, trial, and prototype machines.  
Test and validate machine concepts, machine functions, software features, and technology components during research, prototype, and pre\-series phases.  
Ensure machine functionality, reliability, and performance while documenting results and recommending product and process improvements.  
Investigate and analyze technical challenges in internal laboratories as well as at customer sites.  
Act as a 3rd\-level technical expert for preparation machines, providing support to Service Engineers, Customer Technology teams, and customers.  
Support troubleshooting, optimization, and performance improvement activities for installed machines, including on\-site customer visits when required.  
Plan, execute, monitor, and evaluate lifetime testing activities and analyze machine performance and reliability data.  
Provide structured feedback to development teams to support continuous product improvement.  
Collaborate closely with Technical Product Owners (TPOs), Competence Centers, Process Analytics, Digital Solutions, Customer Technology teams, and customers.  
Contribute to the continuous improvement of the spinning system.  
Train and support Service Engineers and Customer Technologists and facilitate knowledge sharing and best\-practice transfer across functions.  
Your Profile  
Technical background as a Service Engineer, Textile Engineer, or equivalent.  
Practical experience with combing and drawframe technologies.  
Knowledge of blowroom and carding processes is an advantage.  
Experience working with textile machinery and/or within spinning mills.  
Good understanding of textile preparation and spinning processes.  
Fluent English (mandatory).  
German is an advantage.  
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, especially Word and Excel.  
Willingness to travel internationally up to 30%.

an international working environment with long tradition  
versatile activity in a future\-oriented environment with a lot of self\-responsibility  
good development opportunities and fair employment conditions  
a motivated team with mutual respect and good cooperation

title: IT Project Manager
description:
IT Project Manager (TIC Single Data Entry)  
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.  
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.  
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF  
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?  
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.  
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.  
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.  
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.  
Context \& mission  
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man\-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).  
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centres.  
Context:  
The Single Data Entry (SDE) project is a transformational initiative led by MSF to significantly improve the quality and efficiency of supply chain data entry in stock management processes (cargo reception, order preparation, stock count) across multiple operational centres (OC). The solution being developed revolves around a mobile application leveraging QR codes and AI\-powered OCR technologies to automate data capture and integrate with MSF’s existing supply chain systems. The project team is looking for an application manager to bring technical expertise and a capacity to coordinate with IT organizations across OCs to execute its test \& deployment strategy and define the support model.  
Mission:  
The IT Project Manager is pivotal in developing and implementing the SDE solution to meet high standards and integrate smoothly with existing systems and stock management tools. Responsible for the successful delivery of IT solutions supporting the SDE program, this role ensures both business,  
functional and technical requirements are efficiently met. The IT Project Manager will work closely with diverse stakeholders to develop and implement tailored solutions, ensuring these are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with strategic objectives. In this role, you will provide technical leadership within the SDE core team, manage the product development, and collaborate with technical experts from the four cosponsoring Operational Centers (OCs) of the SDE program.  
We are seeking an experienced IT Project Manager with a robust background in software development and a proven track record in leading mobile application projects. Join us at Médecins Sans Frontières and contribute your expertise!  
Occasional travel to the field or the Geneva Office can be expected.  
Scope of responsibilities  
Collaborate with IT working groups from co\-sponsoring OCs to ensure building a viable, maintainable and deployable solution  
Lead end\-to\-end planning and delivery of the product development project  
Collaborate and build relationship with suppliers to enable project success  
Monitor project progress and performance, identify variances, and drive corrective actions to keep delivery on track.  
Identify, assess and manage risks, issues, blockers and dependencies, including escalation where needed.  
Ensure readiness and support go\-live of the solution in MSF missions  
Coordinate testing, defect resolution, environment readiness, release planning and go\-live activities, in collaboration with the Deployment Manager.  
Promote adherence to quality standards, security requirements, compliance needs, and operational readiness expectations.  
Lead workshop and activities to define the operating model and ensure successful transition to business\-as\-usual after implementation  
Your profile

title: Internisten (m/w/d) für die umfassende Patientenversorgung in der Schweiz (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin)
description:
Für mehrere Regionen in der Schweiz suchen wir zur erweiterten Grundversorgung von Patienten mehrere Internisten und Internistinnen. Die Kliniken, für die wir aktiv suchen, engagieren sich nach neuestem Wissensstand in der Inneren Medizin.
Indem sie sich mit anderen Gesundheitsexperten in der Schweiz vernetzen, ermöglichen sie eine umfassende und hochwirksame Versorgung. Man legt großen Wert auf medizinische Qualität und persönliche Behandlung. Dazu gehört, dass für jede Patientin und Patienten eine individuell abgestimmte Therapie ermöglicht wird. Die Bedürfnisse aller Patientinnen und Patienten stehen stets an erster Stelle.

Unsere starke Partnerschaft mit Kliniken aus dem ganzen Land ermöglicht Ihnen eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung und eine schnelle Anstellung.

Für mehrere äußerst interessante Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Personen als

Internistin oder Internist für die Patientenversorgung in einem Schweizer Kanton Ihrer Wahl.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Die folgenden Punkte variieren je nach Standort ein wenig.

- **Diagnose, Behandlung und Prävention:** Internisten befassen sich mit der Vorbeugung, Diagnose und konservativen (nicht-chirurgischen) Behandlung von Krankheiten der inneren Organe. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.
- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:
Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.
- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:
Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. EKG, Lungenfunktion) notwendig sind, ordnen diese an und interpretieren die Ergebnisse.
- Erstellung von Behandlungsplänen:
Basierend auf der Diagnose entwickeln sie individuelle Behandlungspläne, verschreiben Medikamente und überwachen den Therapieerfolg.
- Betreuung chronischer Erkrankungen:
Sie sind häufig die erste Anlaufstelle und betreuen Patienten mit chronischen Erkrankungen.
- Beratung zu Krankheitsmanagement und Prävention:
Sie beraten Patienten umfassend zum Umgang mit ihrer Krankheit, zu präventiven Maßnahmen und zur Gesundheitsförderung.
- Koordination der Patientenversorgung:
Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Fachärzten (z.B. Chirurgen, Kardiologen, Rheumatologen) und anderen Gesundheitsberufen zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche und interdisziplinäre Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.
- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:
In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.
- Umfassende Betreuung:
Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. Sie sind auch in der Palliativmedizin tätig, um Patienten mit nicht heilbaren Krankheiten zu betreuen.
- Führungsverantwortung, Lehre und Forschung:
Sie übernehmen auch Führungsaufgaben in Kliniken, engagieren sich in der Ausbildung des medizinischen Nachwuchses und sind an wissenschaftlicher Forschung beteiligt.

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

- Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (AIM) gerne mit Spezialisierung sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen
(EU-Facharzttitel, EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Berufserfahrung mindestens 2 Jahre
- Freude an Teamarbeit, am Teaching von Kolleginnen/Kollegen in Weiterbildung und an konstruktiver, interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit einer patienten-, kunden- und mitarbeiterorientierten Grundhaltung und hohem Engagement
- Erfahrung in einer angiologischen (Kader-)Stellung
Qualifikation für die Durchführung von PTA von Vorteil
- Interesse und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen beim Bewerbungsbeginn nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch beim Stellenantritt. Bei der Einreichung der Unterlagen kann auf unsere Erfahrung zurückgegriffen werden.
- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. C1-Zertifikat

Leistungen der Anstellung

- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
- Das Gehalt liegt bei ca. CHF 170.000,- bis CHF 200.000,- brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit und bemisst sich je nach Berufserfahrung, Aus- und Weiterbildung

description:
Responsable du Secrétariat de l’Organisation du monde du travail (OrTra) Police, domaine Certification, à 100 % / Leitung der Geschäftsstelle Organisation der Arbeitswelt (OdA) Polizei, Fachbereich Zertifizierung , 100 %  
L’Institut Suisse de Police (ISP) est le centre de compétences pour la formation de base et continue des polices suisses et garantit la mise en œuvre d’une doctrine de formation sur le plan national. En plus de proposer des cours pour les cadres et spécialistes, il coordonne les examens professionnels et professionnels supérieurs des policières et policiers ainsi que la certification des assistantes et assistants de sécurité publique. Soutenue par la Confédération, les cantons et les communes, cette fondation de droit privé développe les moyens d’enseignement destinés à la formation policière et promeut la recherche appliquée sur des thématiques d’intérêt pour la police.  
Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous mettons au concours le poste suivant (entrée en fonction de suite ou à convenir) :  
\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*  
Das Schweizerische Polizei\-Institut (SPI) ist das Kompetenzzentrum für die Aus\- und Weiterbildung der Polizeien und gewährleistet die Umsetzung einer nationalen Ausbildungsdoktrin. Es bietet Kurse für Fach\- und Führungspersonen an und koordiniert die eidgenössischen Berufs\- und höheren Fachprüfungen für Polizistinnen und Polizisten sowie die Zertifizierung der polizeilichen Sicherheitsassistenz. Darüber hinaus entwickelt es Lernmedien für die Polizeiausbildung und fördert die angewandte Forschung zu polizeirelevanten Themen. Das SPI ist eine privatrechtliche Stiftung und wird von Bund, Kantonen und Gemeinden getragen.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams schreiben wir folgende Stelle aus (Stellenantritt per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung):  
Responsable du Secrétariat de l’Organisation du monde du travail (OrTra) Police, domaine Certification, à 100 % / Leitung der Geschäftsstelle Organisation der Arbeitswelt (OdA) Polizei, Fachbereich Zertifizierung , 100 %  
Vos missions principales  
– Conduite opérationnelle : diriger le Secrétariat de l’OrTra Police du point de vue métier, organisationnel et institutionnel en participant à la définition de ses axes stratégiques pour les années à venir. Cette fonction implique également de piloter diverses commissions.  
– Concepts d’examen innovants : veiller à une intégration pertinente des technologies modernes afin d’adapter le système d’examen axé sur les compétences.  
– Tâches courantes : dans le cadre de cours et de workshops, préparer les expert·e·s aux examens ainsi que les mentor·e·s de toute la Suisse à leurs missions et assurer leur accompagnement.  
– Réseautage et collaboration : entretenir les échanges avec des institutions partenaires afin de créer des synergies et d’améliorer en permanence le système d’examen de la police. Cette fonction suppose également de représenter le président de l’OrTra Police au sein d’organes et de groupes de travail au niveau national et international.  
Votre profil  
– Diplôme universitaire ou d’une haute école spécialisée dans le domaine de la formation ou de la sécurité  
– Plusieurs années d’expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de la sécurité publique, de préférence dans la police  
– Capacité à intégrer des concepts de formation innovants avec les technologies et méthodes les plus récentes  
– Plusieurs années d’expérience en coordination de projets ainsi qu’en planification et réalisation de programmes de formation constituent un plus  
– Connaissances du système de formation suisse  
– Maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, l’italien est un atout  
– Méthode de travail structurée, flexibilité, esprit d’initiative et capacité à présenter des thématiques complexes de ère claire et convaincante  
– Volonté et motivation à faire évoluer le système d’examen de la police vers l’avenir  
Nous vous offrons  
– Une activité variée au sein d’un institut national de renom  
– Un environnement stimulant et collaboratif  
– Une culture du travail moderne : flexibilité horaire, télétravail, autonomie  
– Des prestations sociales attrayantes  
Nous avons suscité votre intérêt ?  
– Candidature : via JobUp avec dossier complet (CV, lettre de motivation, copies de diplômes et certificats)  
– Contact : Madame Dilini Jeanneret, vice\-directrice, cheffe du département Formation, recherche et innovation,  
– Informations complémentaires :  
Une mission qui a du sens vous attend, rejoignez notre équipe.  
\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*  
Ihre Hauptaufgaben  
– Operative Führung: Sie leiten die Geschäftsstelle OdA Polizei in fachlicher, organisatorischer und institutioneller Hinsicht und prägen deren strategische Ausrichtung für die nächsten Jahre mit. In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie ausserdem den Vorsitz mehrerer Kommissionen.  
– Innovative Prüfungskonzepte: Sie gewährleisten eine zweckmässige Integration moderner Technologien, um das Prüfungssystem auf berufliche Handlungskompetenzen auszurichten.  
– Arbeit an der Front: In Lehrgängen und Workshops bereiten Sie die Prüfungsexperten/\-innen und Mentoren/\-innen schweizweit auf ihre Aufgabe vor und stellen ihre Betreuung sicher.  
– Netzwerkbildung und Kooperationen: Sie pflegen den Austausch mit Partnerinstitutionen, um Synergien zu schaffen und das polizeiliche Prüfungssystem kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Dabei vertreten Sie den Vorsitzenden der OdA in nationalen und internationalen Gremien und Arbeitsgruppen.

title: IT Service Management Manager

Established in 1927, SICPA is a Swiss private technology company that supports the effective governance and long\-term prosperity of nations.  
SICPA sets the pulse of sovereignty, enabling governments to protect their citizens, sovereign assets, and economies. Best known for securing the majority of the world’s banknotes, SICPA operates across five continents. Today, our platform for sovereignty delivers integrated solutions safeguarding revenue mobilisation, natural resources, health, and brand protection as well as digital sovereignty and secure public services.  
IT Service Management Manager  
We are looking for an experienced IT Service Management Manager to define, operate and manage IT service delivery for SICPA's Private Cloud Operations environment using ITIL service management as the foundation.  
In this role, you will embed service management capabilities and ownership within Cloud Operations teams, drive transparency and reporting across operational activities, and contribute to the delivery of governance practices covering change management, disaster recovery, security, business continuity and audit. You will also support the setup of newly established.  
ROLE  
Service Delivery \& ITSM  
• Define and manage IT service delivery for the private cloud, using ITIL service management as the method  
• Embed service\-management ownership and mindset within the Cloud Operations team's existing roles  
• Drive consistent adoption of the company's ITIL processes within the team's roles

title: IT Service Management Manager
description:
IT Service Management Manager  
Established in 1927, SICPA is a Swiss private technology company that supports the effective governance and long\-term prosperity of nations.  
SICPA sets the pulse of sovereignty, enabling governments to protect their citizens, sovereign assets, and economies. Best known for securing the majority of the world’s banknotes, SICPA operates across five continents. Today, our platform for sovereignty delivers integrated solutions safeguarding revenue mobilisation, natural resources, health, and brand protection as well as digital sovereignty and secure public services.  
IT Service Management Manager  
We are looking for an experienced IT Service Management Manager to define, operate and manage IT service delivery for SICPA's Private Cloud Operations environment using ITIL service management as the foundation.  
In this role, you will embed service management capabilities and ownership within Cloud Operations teams, drive transparency and reporting across operational activities, and contribute to the delivery of governance practices covering change management, disaster recovery, security, business continuity and audit. You will also support the setup of newly established.  
ROLE  
Service Delivery \& ITSM  
• Define and manage IT service delivery for the private cloud, using ITIL service management as the method  
• Embed service\-management ownership and mindset within the Cloud Operations team's existing roles  
• Drive consistent adoption of the company's ITIL processes within the team's roles  
• Strengthen incident and problem management  
Governance \& Reporting  
• Establish transparency, evidence and reporting internally first  
• Establish IT KPIs for the infrastructure and operation, and service KPIs for business reviews  
• Ensure transparency and adherence reporting for the centrally governed domains (security, business continuity, audit)  
Stakeholder Management  
• Lead the service relationship with Digital Business Operation team  
• Act as the cloud service provider's interface to the consuming business operations  
• Understand and channel hosting requirements; report and review hosting service performance  
• Maintain the service relationship through reporting and reviews  
Change Management \& Operational Resilience  
• Establish and embed risk\-based change management, owned by the team and aligned to the company process  
• Ensure the required DRP for each solution is planned, conducted, tracked and formally reported  
Community \& JV Support  
• Participate in the company\-wide IT community, exchanging knowledge on best practices with local IT operations  
• Support the setup of JV IT organizations  
• Act as main liaison with a new JV's IT team and lead the contribution to its setup  
PROFILE• Substantial IT Service Management and governance experience, with a track record of establishing and embedding practice within an operational team• Experience defining IT service delivery / operating models• Experience in a data center, cloud, hosting or infrastructure\-provider environment• Experience leading an operational or engineering team's adoption and ownership of service management• Experience defining IT KPIs and service reporting for an infrastructure or service operation• Proven ability to lead and coordinate cross\-team initiatives• Seniority to engage operational leadership and business stakeholders as a credible peer • Strong working knowledge of ITIL; ITIL qualification expected• Understanding of cloud and modern infrastructure operations, and how service management integrates with them• Ability to design KPI frameworks and service reporting for both operational and business audiences• Influence without direct authority \- drives adoption through credibility and collaboration, not line control• Credibility with engineers \- earns technical teams' respect and works with their culture• Diplomacy and stakeholder management across organizational boundaries• Fluent in English and French  
WHY JOIN US?  
• Join a global leader in trust technologies with a mission that matters• Be at the strategic heart of a financially sound and innovation\-driven company• Collaborate with high\-level experts and work on impactful international projects• Operate in a multi\-cultural, high\-integrity environment where autonomy and ownership are encouraged jpidc946c46jm jpit0730jm jpiy26jm

description:
Head of Medical Scientific Affairs (ID2121\)  
The AO is a medically guided, not\-for\-profit organization, a global network of surgeons, and the world's leading education, innovation, and research organization specializing in the surgical treatment of trauma and musculoskeletal disorders. We are home to people from all over the world, from different backgrounds, with diverse talents and specialist areas. Head of Medical Scientific Affairs (ID2121\)  
Short Description  
The Head of Medical Scientific Affairs provides strategic and scientific leadership for AO's clinical evidence generation ecosystem and ensures that clinical research investments translate into meaningful improvements in patient care.  
He/she serves as a trusted scientific advisor to AO leadership, governance committees, and clinical divisions and represents AO ITC in internal and external scientific initiatives, partnerships, and expert forums.  
The role is accountable for developing a high\-impact portfolio of clinical studies across Trauma, CMF, Spine,TC, Veterinary, and related orthopedic disciplines, ensuring optimal allocation of resources, scientific excellence, and supporting effective translation of evidence into clinical practice.  
The position serves as a key interface between surgeons, researchers, clinical operations, governance bodies, industry partners, and educational stakeholders to maximize the generation, dissemination, and adoption of evidence\-based innovations within the AO ecosystem.  
Main Responsibilities  
Lead the Medical Scientific Affairs team  
Provide scientific, strategic and operational leadership to the Medical Scientific Affairs team with two direct reports, fostering a high\-performing, collaborative, and service\-oriented culture.  
Define team objectives, priorities, and performance expectations aligned with the organization's strategy and portfolio needs.  
Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate team members to support professional growth, ensuring the appropriate scientific, clinical, and operational competencies are in place.  
Close collaboration with Clinical Operations in the resource planning and allocation across studies, programs, and stakeholder requests to meet organizational objectives.  
Build effective collaboration between surgeons, governance bodies, Clinical Operations, NCR, AO Education Institute, AO Research Institute, educators, and external partners to advance the Clinical Research activities in the AO.  
Drive continuous improvement of Medical Scientific Affairs processes, standards, and capabilities to enhance quality, efficiency, and impact and establish a culture of scientific excellence, integrity, compliance, and evidence\-based decision\-making across all Medical Scientific Affairs activities.  
Lead the Clinical Science Advisory Commission (CSAC).  
Lead the AO ITC Clinical Research Fellowship Program.  
Support the AO PEER program.  
Clinical Study Design \& Scientific Support  
Develop clinical study protocols addressing important knowledge gaps and clinical needs in close collaboration with surgeons, industry partners, governance bodies and Network Clinical Research and Clinical Operations.  
Review and provide medical\-scientific assessment of adverse events and safety\-related findings throughout study conduct.  
Provide expert advice on medical and scientific questions arising during study execution and support preparation of scientific publications, clinical reports, congress abstracts, and other dissemination activities.  
Close collaborate with Clinical Operations in study planning, implementation, and monitoring activities.  
Support interpretation of results in close collaboration with surgeons, investigators, governance bodies, and Clinical Operations.  
Drive excellence in scientific publication strategies, congress presentations, and dissemination activities.  
Clinical Research Portfolio Strategy  
Lead scientific discussions regarding future evidence needs.  
Develop and maintain a strategic clinical research portfolio in collaboration with the Research Commissions and internal stakeholders which is aligned with AO's mission and priorities.  
Establish and continuously refine portfolio prioritization frameworks balancing available research funding, knowledge gaps, patient impact, scientific significance, feasibility, cost\-effectiveness and translational potential and risk\-benefit considerations in collaboration with the Research Commissions and internal stakeholders.  
Monitor portfolio performance with regards to strategic objectives and adapt research priorities based on emerging evidence, and clinical needs.  
Provide scientific leadership across the full research lifecycle, ensuring methodological rigor, clinical relevance, regulatory compliance, and ethical conduct.  
Collaborate with Clinical Operations in establishing a grant acquisition strategy and strengthen industry partnerships and drive grant acquisition.  
Support Knowledge Translation activities to ensure clinical evidence generated by AO is effectively translated into education, clinical guidelines, decision support tools, and clinical practice.  
Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations, NCR, AO Education, AO Clinical Divisions, community development and governance bodies to facilitate adoption of new evidence.  
Lead implementation of health economic and outcomes research initiatives.  
Main Requirements  
Professional \& Technical Skills  
Advanced expertise in clinical research methodology.  
Strong understanding of orthopedic clinical practice and research.  
Advanced expertise in clinical study design, statistical principles, and evidence synthesis.  
Experience in designing and executing industry sponsored clinical studies as a CRO.  
Experience in health economic evaluation and outcomes research.  
Excellent scientific grant and publication writing and presentation skills.  
Sound understanding of regulatory requirements, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and clinical research governance.

Medical Degree (MD) required.  
PhD, MSc, or equivalent advanced scientific qualification highly desirable.  
Formal training in clinical epidemiology, research methodology, biostatistics, or related disciplines is advantageous.  
Professional Experience  
Minimum 10 years of experience in clinical research within orthopedics, trauma, spine, CMF, sports medicine, or related disciplines.  
Experience in multicenter clinical studies from concept generation to publication and dissemination.  
Experience in developing and managing research portfolios and clinical research strategies.

title: Application Engineer - Technology Preparation
description:
Application Engineer \- Technology Preparation  
Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man\-made fibers into short\-staple and long\-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man\-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. Rieter has a history spanning more than 230 years, operates 17 production sites in nine countries, and employs around 4 220 people worldwide, approximately 15\.4% of them in Switzerland. Rieter is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol RIEN.

Context \& mission  
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man\-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).

Context:  
The Single Data Entry (SDE) project is a transformational initiative led by MSF to significantly improve the quality and efficiency of supply chain data entry in stock management processes (cargo reception, order preparation, stock count) across multiple operational centres (OC). functional and technical requirements are efficiently met. The IT Project Manager will work closely with diverse stakeholders to develop and implement tailored solutions, ensuring these are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with strategic objectives. In this role, you will provide technical leadership within the SDE core team, manage the product development, and collaborate with technical experts from the four cosponsoring Operational Centers (OCs) of the SDE program.  
We are seeking an experienced IT Project Manager with a robust background in software development and a proven track record in leading mobile application projects. Join us at Médecins Sans Frontières and contribute your expertise!  
Occasional travel to the field or the Geneva Office can be expected.  
Scope of responsibilities  
Collaborate with IT working groups from co\-sponsoring OCs to ensure building a viable, maintainable and deployable solution

Collaborate and build relationship with suppliers to enable project success

Promote adherence to quality standards, security requirements, compliance needs, and operational readiness expectations.  
Lead workshop and activities to define the operating model and ensure successful transition to business\-as\-usual after implementation

Education  
Master’s degree in computer sciences, information systems, engineering, or a related field)

Broad technical proficiency across various roles, including developer, business analyst, technical lead, and project manager

title: Ausbildung zum Binnenschiffer / Binnenschifffahrtskapitän/in (m/w/d) (Binnenschiffer/in)
description:
Viking ist sehr stolz darauf, Ihnen einen außergewöhnlichen Ausbildungsplatz in der Binnenschifffahrt zu ermöglichen. Als Marktführer in der Flusskreuzfahrt-Branche und mit einer ständig wachsenden Flotte, bietet Viking, in Zusammenarbeit mit den Schweizer und Deutschen Ausbildungsbehörden, ab 01. August 2026 insgesamt 8 Ausbildungsplätze in den Berufen Binnenschiffer/in und Binnenschifffahrtskapitän/in an.

Während der Ausbildung werden Sie mit hochinteressanten Bereichen wie Schiffsführung und- steuerung, Management des Schiffsbetriebs, Führungsqualitäten & Kommunikation und Umweltbewusstsein in Kontakt kommen. Die Ausbildungsdauer zum/zur Binnenschiffer/in beträgt 3 Jahre, zum/zur Binnenschifffahrtskapitän/in 3,5 Jahre.

Programmübersicht

Diese beiden Ausbildungswege sind so gestaltet, dass Sie, nach erfolgreichem Abschluss, ein/e qualifizierte/r Spezialist/in in Navigation und Binnenschifffahrt sind. Dieser Berufszweig genießt ein hohes und professionelles Ansehen und Viking unterstützt die Entwicklung unserer zukünftigen Führungskräfte mit allen Mitteln. Um mit dem erforderlichen Wissen und der Erfahrung für diese Berufe ausgestattet zu sein, sind Sie, während Ihrer Ausbildungszeit, in verschiedene Regionen Europas auf 13 Flüssen unterwegs. Des Weiteren werden Sie auch in unseren Standorten in Wiebelsheim/Deutschland und in Basel/Schweiz präsent sein. Dadurch lernen Sie die geschäftliche Seite unserer Branche kennen und verstehen es besser, Theorie und Praxis mit einander zu verbinden. Zu Beginn jedes Ausbildungsjahres gehen Sie 14 Wochen zur Berufsschule. Im Anschluss daran sammeln Sie praktische Erfahrung auf unseren Schiffen. Während dieser Zeit sind Sie 4 Wochen durchgehend an Bord und anschließend haben Sie zwei Wochen frei.

Für alle Kandidaten, die an einer akademischen Entwicklung interessiert sind, besteht auch die Möglichkeit, nach Abschluss der Ausbildung an einem berufsbegleitenden Studium zum Bachelor of Science Nautik & Hafenlogistik (BSc.), teilzunehmen.

Daten & Dauer

Wir bieten zwei verschiedene Ausbildungswege an. Sie müssen nicht sofort entscheiden, welche Option für Sie die interessantere ist, sondern Sie können sich dafür bis Ende des zweiten Ausbildungsjahres Zeit lassen. Es gibt die Möglichkeit innerhalb von 3 Jahren den Abschluss zum/zur Binnenschiffer/in zu erlangen oder mit einer Erweiterung um 6 Monate das Diplom zum/zur Binnenschifffahrtskapitän/in zu erhalten.

Beide Ausbildungsgänge beginnen am 01. August 2026.

Anstellung & Gehalt

Da Sie aktiv Teil unseres Unternehmens und des Schiffsbetriebes sind, sind Sie nicht einfach nur ein/e Auszubildende/r. Im Verlauf der Ausbildung durchlaufen Sie verschiedene Stationen und Positionen und werden so auf die unterschiedlichen Aufgaben vorbereitet. Hierunter sind die einzelnen Bruttolöhne und Positionen pro Jahr aufgezeigt:

•    Jahr 1: Leichtmatrose, € 1’700
•    Jahr 2: Leichtmatrose, € 2’000
•    Jahr 3: Matrose € 2’300
•    Jahr 4 (nur 6 Monate): 2nd Officer, € 2’800

Sollten Sie sich nach erfolgreichem Abschluss der Ausbildung zum/zur Binnenschifffahrtskapitän/in dafür entscheiden, bei Viking einzusteigen, bieten wir Ihnen einen Arbeitsvertrag als 1st Officer mit einem Einstiegsgehalt von € 4'200 (brutto) pro Monat an.

Berufsschule & Lerninhalte

Die Berufsschule für dieses Ausbildungsprogramm ist das Berufskolleg in Duisburg/Deutschland. Während 14 Wochen Schulzeit pro Jahr werden Sie in theoretischem Wissen über Europas Wasserstraßen unterrichtet und erhalten wertvolle Einblicke in Themen wie Sicherheitsmanagement, Risikobewertung, Administration und die nautische Kommunikation in verschiedenen Sprachen (Englisch, Deutsch, Französisch). Darüber hinaus lernen Sie die spezifischen Aufgaben eines Kapitäns/einer Kapitänin kennen. Diese Aufgaben umfassen, unter anderem, die Kontrolle des Schiffs in unterschiedlichen Situationen und ein intensives Schiffssimulator-Training. Am Ende Ihrer Ausbildung müssen Sie eine Abschlussprüfung absolvieren.

Anforderungen

•    Mindestalter 18 Jahre
•    EU oder Schweizer Staatsbürgerschaft
•    Deutsch B1 (für die erste Prüfung am Ende des 2. Jahres wird B2 benötigt)
•    Gute Englischkenntnisse

Um in dieser Ausbildung und diesem Beruf erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie energisch, flexibel, verlässlich und loyal sein. Sie sollten ein natürliches Interesse an Themen wie Navigation, unserem Einfluss auf die Umwelt und Tourismus mitbringen. Viking ist ein Unternehmen, das sehr schnell auf neue Gegebenheiten reagiert und sich permanent durch Innovationen weiterentwickelt. Wir suchen Auszubildende, die ernsthaft neue Herausforderungen angehen und zeigen möchten, dass Sie die Führungskräfte der Zukunft in unserer Branche sein können.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.
